economy.zh:
**7月29日经济新闻速览**

全球市场在AI抛售与中东冲突双重夹击下剧烈波动。亚洲科技股延续跌势，SK海力士因盈利不及预期暴跌，SoftBank重挫10%，但港股腾讯、美团等逆势上涨。伊朗向美军发射弹道导弹，油价应声跳涨，惠誉报告警告战争溢出效应已拖累欧洲发达经济体。苹果成为史上第二家市值突破5万亿美元的公司，因投资者逃离AI股转向硬件龙头。国内A股存储芯片板块暴跌超6%，2400亿市值兆易创新跌停，但光模块巨头中际旭创董事长提议最高80亿元回购，ETF资金昨日整体净流入253亿元。

- **[亚洲科技股抛售延续，SK海力士盈利超预期仍遭抛售](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/sk-hynix-earnings-profit-revenue-hbm-memory.html)**：SK海力士利润与营收呈指数级增长，但未达到AI板块分析师过高预期，股价暴跌。软银重挫10%，港股中国互联网股逆势走强，腾讯、美团、百度、快手均上涨。
- **[伊朗突袭美军基地，油价飙升](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-iran-us-hormuz.html)**：伊朗向中东美军发射弹道导弹，所有导弹被拦截，但中东紧张局势再度升级，油价大幅上涨。沙特正通过地中海港口以更高成本出口石油寻求替代路线。
- **[苹果突破5万亿美元市值](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jul/28/apple-second-ever-5tn-company-as-investors-flee-ai-stocks)**：投资者逃离AI和半导体板块，苹果受益于强劲产品需求和避开AI军备竞赛的决策，股价创历史新高，成为继英伟达后第二家市值超5万亿美元的公司。
- **[A股存储芯片板块暴跌，光模块龙头大手笔回购](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1BV1VZYTJqb1RUY1UybjVvakZ5MkROblY1ZFBuUk9EWnM5YlRyc0p3SHdFbHFVVjlsVWI3ajRBd05kTG1YcFkydlpQUVhUaVh3RUdzcjNHVWR4Z2ZHZjRGU3Zn)**：受全球AI芯片抛售波及，A股存储芯片指数跳水超6%，兆易创新跌停；但光模块巨头中际旭创董事长提议回购最高80亿元，彰显信心。
- **[韩国交易所启动熔断机制](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE1BTHFpTm1PVU1KeHBURFZKU21yZUZWR3dla3FHWUl3YUNITTVKa1p3NU83LUt6aG9vV0RmUV9fNGpMZWJrSlBwckFpLXMzcmVBT253)**：韩国KOSPI指数跌至三个月新低，三星和SK海力士跌幅均超10%，交易所触发熔断，AI支出担忧与中国芯片竞争双重打击。
- **[美联储公布货币政策工作组领导层与目标](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260709a.htm)**：美联储宣布成立两个工作组推进货币政策实施，同时发布银行检查中敏感信息处理联合声明，显示监管层正多维度强化金融体系韧性。

**后续观察**：AI板块的“盈利疲劳”正从韩国、日本蔓延至全球，英伟达、谷歌等巨头财报后的资本支出审查将成为本周焦点。中东冲突若持续升级，油价和通胀预期可能迫使央行重新评估降息路径。中国科技股在AI抛售中展现韧性，需关注周末公布的PMI数据能否巩固这一分化趋势。
economy.en:
Markets were buffeted by a deepening rout in AI-related stocks and a renewed spike in geopolitical risk after Iran launched a ballistic missile attack on U.S. forces, sending oil sharply higher. Chinese internet stocks listed in Hong Kong provided a rare bright spot, while Apple crossed the $5tn mark as investors rotated away from high-spending AI plays. In Europe, earnings reports offered some support, but the Iran conflict’s spillovers into developed economies remain a key risk. The next 24 hours bring crucial hyperscaler earnings from Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft, as well as the Eurozone GDP flash estimate, which will test the resilience of risk appetite.

- **AI rout intensifies across Asia**: SK Hynix shares tanked after exponential earnings growth failed to meet AI-inflated expectations, dragging SoftBank down 10% and triggering South Korea's KOSPI circuit breaker. However, Seagate's after-hours earnings beat offered a glimmer of hope for the battered AI trade ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/sk-hynix-earnings-profit-revenue-hbm-memory.html), [MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/seagates-earnings-are-welcome-news-for-the-battered-ai-trade-92dfc30f)).
- **Iran attack jolts oil markets**: Iran launched a ballistic missile attack on U.S. forces, all intercepted, but oil prices jumped sharply as the U.S.-Iran cycle of strikes resumed ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-iran-us-hormuz.html)). Saudi Arabia is using a costlier Mediterranean backdoor to keep exports flowing ([MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/saudi-arabia-has-a-new-and-pricier-workaround-to-export-its-oil-fb5085a5)).
- **Apple hits $5tn as investors flee AI stocks**: Apple became the second company ever to reach a $5tn valuation, benefiting from strong product demand and its decision to sit out the AI spending race ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jul/28/apple-second-ever-5tn-company-as-investors-flee-ai-stocks)).
- **Chinese internet stocks buck the sell-off**: Tencent, Meituan, Baidu, and Kuaishou all traded higher in Hong Kong, diverging from the regional AI-driven weakness ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/chip-selloff-sk-hynix-samsung-softbank.html)).
- **U.S. bans Chinese humanoid robots**: The Trump administration escalated tech tensions with a ban on Chinese humanoid robots, intensifying the U.S.-China race for leadership in robotics and AI ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp9e2ex3ekyo)).
- **Ford raises guidance after Q2 beat**: Ford cited operational improvements, resilient pricing, and strong F-Series mix for the positive outlook ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/ford-motor-f-earnings-q2-2026.html)).
- **Standard Chartered posts record profit, $1bn buyback**: The London-headquartered lender’s first-half net profit rose 10% to a record $3.37bn, though an impairment charge tied to the Middle East conflict weighed ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362209/standard-chartered-posts-10-rise-first-half-profit-launches-us1b-buy-back)).
- **Europe feels the heat from Iran war**: Fitch warned that Iran war spillovers are straining developed Europe’s economy in 2026 ([IndexBox](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNSFNjSGhLeGJCb0ZOTWNqTjg0eE1HYkw2MkczVjVJajZiMXpEbVlYNEhwLUh6TXFlSENOclN4N1BWLXdsTi1OZzlKcUdOMEptZFhzc2JhM2pFcTRUeDJWaFkwWXdyNGRkaTVnbkNZb0tyOHFRWEpScDBkd2xqN25BWGpHUVQydVZKZzF1WVRSbWJCdw)).

**Watch next**: Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft report this week under intense scrutiny over capital spending and free cash flow after Alphabet’s disappointing results. Eurozone Q2 GDP flash estimate on Thursday will be critical for ECB’s September rate decision. In Asia, the trajectory of Chinese AI stocks and any further chip-related fallout will set the tone.

**今日社会新闻综述**

全球社会新闻今日多线并发：中东战火再起，伊朗向驻约旦美军发射弹道导弹，打破五天停火期；日本九州岛遭遇6.8级强震，死亡人数已升至13人，搜救仍在紧张进行；韩国股市因芯片股崩盘暴跌近11%，触发熔断，恐慌情绪蔓延；美国西雅图美食节枪击案致三人死亡，社区举行悼念。此外，法国野火因热浪复燃，墨西哥贩毒集团将冰毒实验室外包至尼日利亚，以及日本著名作家东野圭吾去世等消息也引发关注。

- **中东再燃战火**：伊朗向驻约旦美军发射多枚弹道导弹，美军中央司令部称成功拦截。此前双方刚经历五天停火，局势骤然升级。（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c70g6y24d76o)、[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/29/iran-missiles-target-us-forces-in-jordan-after-a-five-day-pause-in-war)）
- **日本九州强震**：熊本县发生震度7级地震，已致13人死亡，数百人受伤，电力、供水中断影响数万人。自卫队出动数千人救援，韩国部分地区亦有震感。（[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/29/japan-earthquake-death-aftershocks)、[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cvg7v55gxnqo)）
- **韩国股市暴跌**：KOSPI指数单日下挫近11%，芯片股遭大规模抛售，SK海力士虽创纪录利润仍未能提振市场。投资者担忧全球经济放缓与AI需求降温。（[Daily American Republic](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxNc1lFY3NpRzFvbU9IWGVFSVItMXcxb2JydVVfOXdlNFRCYzE1T2MzRHQtRlFuY3dpcHJJeXdJMERqRC1aY0xhczNnTVVfaUVndHg3cUxhOW5zcVpxbG5GaHJJZ1JNdVlqUzhuNjRfazdjeC1FclY2V2NObl9BQ2tHNzVfSS0xd2c5MHIxLXdTUHo2WTd2WjBsdE5fa2xIVjRpakRaY2ZpX0JtMWNYbGNfWXRFMWcyTmtYekc2RTVxa2xzbWtKVTRWRVZ0VTA)）
- **西雅图枪击案**：西雅图美食节枪击案三名遇难者身份公布，亲属哀悼并呼吁加强枪支管控。该事件引发社区对公共安全的讨论。（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgv7m5z4n0o)）
- **法国野火复燃**：西南部吉伦特省野火因40℃热浪重新蔓延，消防员面临严峻挑战，当局警告居民撤离。（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yd8gly1ydo)）
- **毒品贸易新动向**：墨西哥贩毒集团将冰毒生产外包至尼日利亚，西非正成为全球毒品制造与出口的新中心。（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crmrnxp4nllo)）
- **东野圭吾逝世**：日本著名推理小说家东野圭吾去世，享年68岁。其作品在全球拥有大量读者，文学界表示哀悼。（[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/07/28/national/keigo-higashino-dies/)）
- **中国教育与社会**：教育部举办高等教育数字化研讨班；新疆数字经济发展受关注；《中国农村发展报告2026》发布，聚焦乡村振兴。（[新华社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5uLW5lcE9VWFVaTDVmTS13UVV2VWF3WVdwYlkyWE9SZ1dhbkh1M2YySWdSbXUzN19aRHdiS29HalFBRVo4aDV6MGNPRkd3SjhLbzNhWXVnMnVfYUV2Tkd5REViMWllM09iSkhj)、[中国网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE9XdEdIYUxUWjU5NFFFLWczQUdEbkF4S1hGaG9zSjZON0t4alJhQUNDcTQ0RHhJSTlXQml5ekRjNmRYLTAwMUZfam9GMVdkdjltWm90YnE0YUVBSnJYTW1tRGU1eHZnSktkdVM0)）

**后续观察**：中东局势或将进一步升级，需关注伊朗与美国的直接对抗风险；日本地震灾后重建及核电站安全亟需关注；韩国股市暴跌可能引发亚洲市场连锁反应，需持续跟踪半导体行业动向。

The last 24 hours have been dominated by a sharp escalation in US-Iran hostilities, a devastating earthquake in southern Japan, and a severe sell-off in South Korean equities, while domestic Chinese news focused on policy and social stability. The re-emergence of direct Iran-US military exchanges after a five-day pause risks a broader regional war, and the magnitude 7 earthquake on Kyushu island has already claimed lives and disrupted critical infrastructure. Meanwhile, South Korea's KOSPI plunge of nearly 11%—triggered by panic selling of chipmakers—signals deepening anxiety over the global AI memory cycle. Below are the key developments you need to track.

- **[Iran and US trade strikes, shattering brief lull in fighting](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c70g6y24d76o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** – US Central Command confirms interception of multiple Iranian ballistic missiles targeting US forces in Jordan, ending a five-day pause. The Al Jazeera report notes Riyadh and Washington also launched joint strikes on Iran-backed groups in Iraq, widening the theater of conflict.
- **[Japan earthquake death toll rises as rescue teams search for missing](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/29/japan-earthquake-death-aftershocks)** – At least 13 dead, hundreds injured, and tens of thousands without power and water after a 6.8 magnitude quake struck Kyushu. A blast at a Kumamoto mall and building collapses complicate rescue efforts; military has mobilized thousands. (See also [BBC video](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cvg7v55gxnqo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) and [Reuters report](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQREx4N194TTNIVm1ocmk3TEpxZ3hPSVpKQ2dwdEpuOTZNVXNsWVNjX1pjSGhkTHh6M01iWFZQeENTQ09KTHNQSzl0TzdwWGJqN2lrMmV2Vng4Z19ISUZWM1l3NXU1U2ptMENYZVRqSzd5Y0pLelAtOHJHZ19jbm5IdXhmYjhuekNDLW9aV1BvQUtUTTlLOWZhemRNSF81MS1LSXYybms2UGliMzhHaW14SW52V2ZOZw))
- **[South Korea's Kospi share index falls nearly 7%](https://news.google.)** – Heavy selling of chipmakers drove the KOSPI down nearly 11% at one point, triggering circuit breakers. The rout followed SK hynix's record profit report, suggesting the market is pricing in a peak in AI memory demand.
- **[Netanyahu to meet Trump in a first encounter since the Iran war began](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/28/g-s1-135833/trump-netanyahu-iran-war)** – Both leaders face domestic pressures: Netanyahu's re-election campaign and Trump's unpopular war. The meeting could reshape US-Israel coordination on Iran.
- **[Wildfires in south-west France flare up as region braces for new 40C heatwave](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yd8gly1ydo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** – Firefighters in Gironde face a sharp temperature rise complicating containment efforts—a reminder of accelerating climate extremes.
- **[China's tax big data shows H1 economic highlights](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPUy1uR1VBUFRPVnJwVUNUYl94WWFVNmFaS3Fqa243czkwYmhrajZNT1o5T0RIblBnM0xMRTk5aHFYT0hZRXhuaExsX3hodzBjc2hrQnVyLWhKZU5QT3RmcUhfdUsydWhxTDBpWEZkRmdmLXJvSl9TN2FpcnM5d2dUbl9uanl6em5h)** – Official data signals steady recovery; watch for implications for policy easing.

**Watch next:** The Iran-US missile exchange could escalate further if retaliatory strikes target Iranian soil. Japan's earthquake rescue operations are in a critical 72-hour window, while South Korea's market rout may prompt emergency policy measures. Also keep an eye on the Netanyahu-Trump summit for signs of a shift in war strategy.

## 军事新闻日报 · 2026-07-29

**导语：** 24小时内，中东局势急剧升级——伊朗向美军发起弹道导弹突袭，美军防空库存被指接近极限；同时乌克兰与伊朗冲突在里海交汇，两场战争正加速融合。美国暂停对伊打击后，转而强化印太布局，中国则在台海与南海持续施压。以下是关键动态与判断。

- **伊朗突袭美军，防空库存告急**：伊朗于7月28日向驻中东美军发射多枚弹道导弹，美国军方定性为“企图突袭”。[WSJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQYm1mNVNLLVJxQ012SmI5ejdTQlRnZzVXRVpzWFdkMnVLMEVPN2Etby1FUmNDZzViOGo0SFhWU21lYkFaZzVRVlFRZ3pqUGN2S1dUZWVDb2V2T2pSTjhNOTF4dHpOZl9MdUlib0tPQmNEeFpoV2hxRjRBSXlZMW1sTk5FbkxaSk5ybUNKdHdtYjdFenh1OFdCT054R3lxNEE)和[BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5FSzhZbndQb2lHQ1lnZ3FRaHdYZ1FLVGMzM1AxdnFvWWE3cW9FQW1CYlBYOGxrTnVJdXJCbXloU2V1b29xS0w0dHZYMFlNaGN2bUtxNUZ1ZXdJZw)等多家媒体确认。分析指出，美军“爱国者”等防空弹药库存因长期消耗已近临界点，[Sun Sentinel](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9yZi1NNnd1bEpuR0V6VFJjNUNFYnJBdEFpNXJqRUhBU0ZqQ2VOY3hLOGlla1lXajFXU09odFl5ZXVZVU9vQy1TbE9nTmk0SFdkckRyWl9nSjRTNlVSUGxIM3laM1ZLWnZXWnc)援引报告称库存承压。
- **乌克兰与伊朗冲突在里海交叉**：乌克兰对一艘伊朗船只发动袭击，造成一名伊朗水兵死亡，伊朗威胁报复。[NYT](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxOdjB0cGJvaWsyd04zZFBHc1FERzZzb2NqQmx4YXB5amtxek5rQ05iRENiWG5xeXo3UnBJTzhsbzgtWUtLamJlMXpyem9wblZ0MDdQMklLdy1XalNyRVlpdVltRU5tZkc5ZDdkRmZ1Y28tOW1NWEE4MXhBbDBWaWxQb3o1TkR0WTdTZ1dSeW9hOXA5SWNm)与[Newsweek](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOTUhRLVV6Z0J0VmFmZ3hEYTB5UDdoeTBKb2NCSDNPWnZNNW9qRWZUYVFlNUVUQlR4cHVtcWl3QkkyYVVSR3dCaEdWY0dReFBNQ29MVTZNUjZILUI0azlzUkstbm1wbnJZaFQwNXhVdGdabkVDTUtjcVdGajg0V29uMmFiZHZNRi01elN4NA)指出，乌克兰与伊朗战争正“融合”为同一危机，特朗普政府被迫同时应对两条战线。
- **特朗普暂停打击，但威胁持续**：特朗普称与伊朗的“会谈良好”，同时重申打击威胁；[The Guardian](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxQS3NoUEVwZmd3bkhmSTZGdEVDOGNEOVFaY3RnUFZTRjJLdmdPMjFmNU5UTzhXS3h5MEZmdlp6b0dScHlKcUJhUmNSU3hqTnM5TEJsbXQ1dlE3elFiVjNfNXprVnVvdDVTVDk2VVpldHhJLTFFRDdheXlqYWFodFF0bHVRR202UFhRZUE)评论认为，暂停本身暴露美军力量有限。美海军航母动态显示，对伊打击虽暂停，但海上封锁未解除。[TWZ](https://www.twz.com/sea/where-are-the-aircraft-carriers-july-28-2026)
- **中国军力展示与南海博弈**：解放军在渤海海峡及黄海部分海域执行军事任务；直升机与无人机首次同时越过台海中线进入管控区域。[朝鲜日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxPX0JhTXV4OGtzaWU4OHBHc0gyOTlLOVdPU2Vac2djOVNFSjJfV0VtVXJ5TXhHd21SSEhFQUg3Vnp2MmdWN3NrYTB3UmFRTnF5N2NsbG9hQWF3Z09pMUlZQjFiQVpVUXJDQURveXFMOXJBUjJzMW8yUEpkZkpUcWFaRmJ4UlJ1M3FfZzhJYnp3)美国智库报告则聚焦中国核武库增长。[TWZ](https://www.twz.com/nuclear/a-guide-to-chinas-growing-long-range-nuclear-missile-arsenal)
- **印太：美强化菲律宾基地，中俄联合巡逻**：美国承诺资助菲律宾海岸警卫队扩建巴拉望基地，并增加军事融资。[USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/28/u-s-to-fund-philippine-coast-guard-base-expansion-near-south-china-sea)中俄海军在日本北海道附近举行年度联合巡逻，日方侦察确认。[USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/28/joint-russian-chinese-navy-patrol-sails-near-japan)国会同时要求海军大幅增加鱼雷库存以支撑“两场战争”战略。[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-torpedo-inventory-fy27-ndaa/)
- **美军装备战线**：最后一架MV-22“鱼鹰”交付海军陆战队，预计服役至2055年。[TWZ](https://www.twz.com/air/usmc-just-took-delivery-of-its-last-mv-22-osprey)而“企业”号航母报废账单已达13亿美元。[USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/28/final-bill-for-inactivating-scrapping-carrier-enterprise-now-at-1-3b)此外，波音在“空军一号”项目上已额外承担30亿美元超支。[TWZ](https://www.twz.com/air/boeing-has-now-eaten-3b-in-air-force-one-cost-overruns)

**后续观察：** 伊朗突袭与乌克兰行动的联动，很可能迫使美国重新评估中东兵力部署。中国在台海与南海军力展示持续，美国虽暂停对伊打击，但印太方向投入不减。美伊外交窗口期极短，一旦破裂将引爆更大范围冲突。

The last 24 hours have been defined by a dramatic escalation in the Middle East, as Iran launched a surprise missile attack against U.S. forces, triggering a rapid reassessment of American force posture and air defense stockpiles. Simultaneously, a Ukrainian strike on an Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea is blurring the lines between two major conflicts, while China continues to assert itself in the South China Sea and Taiwan Strait. This brief synthesizes the most consequential developments across four desks—international security, conflict dynamics, China military affairs, and naval/Indo-Pacific operations—to provide actionable intelligence.

- **Iran launches 'attempted surprise attack' on U.S. forces**: Multiple ballistic missiles were fired at American troops and air defense positions, with the U.S. military confirming the strike. Reports indicate air defense stockpiles are nearing limits, raising concerns about sustainability ([WSJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQYm1mNVNLLVJxQ012SmI5ejdTQlRnZzVXRVpzWFdkMnVLMEVPN2Etby1FUmNDZzViOGo0SFhWU21lYkFaZzVRVlFRZ3pqUGN2S1dUZWVDb2V2T2pSTjhNOTF4dHpOZl9MdUlib0tPQmNEeFpoV2hxRjRBSXlZMW1sTk5FbkxaSk5ybUNKdHdtYjdFenh1OFdCT054R3lxNEE), [BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5FSzhZbndQb2lHQ1lnZ3FRaHdYZ1FLVGMzM1AxdnFvWWE3cW9FQW1CYlBYOGxrTnVJdXJCbXloU2V1b29xS0w0dHZYMFlNaGN2bUtxNUZ1ZXdJZw), [PBS](https://news.google.)).
- **Ukraine-Iran wars collide**: Ukraine struck an Iranian ship in the Caspian Sea, killing one sailor and prompting Iranian threats of retaliation. This incident, combined with the U.S.-Iran exchange, is merging two conflict theaters ([NYT](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxOdjB0cGJvaWsyd04zZFBHc1FERzZzb2NqQmx4YXB5amtxek5rQ05iRENiWG5xeXo3UnBJTzhsbzgtWUtLamJlMXpyem9wblZ0MDdQMklLdy1XalNyRVlpdVltRU5tZkc5ZDdkRmZ1Y28tOW1NWEE4MXhBbDBWaWxQb3o1TkR0WTdTZ1dSeW9hOXA5SWNm), [Newsweek](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOTUhRLVV6Z0J0VmFmZ3hEYTB5UDdoeTBKb2NCSDNPWnZNNW9qRWZUYVFlNUVUQlR4cHVtcWl3QkkyYVVSR3dCaEdWY0dReFBNQ29MVTZNUjZILUI0azlzUkstbm1wbnJZaFQwNXhVdGdabkVDTUtjcVdGajg0V29uMmFiZHZNRi01elN4NA)).
- **China expands military activities**: Chinese helicopters and drones crossed the Taiwan Strait median line for the first time simultaneously, while a joint Russia-China naval patrol sailed near Japan. Beijing also issued a navigation warning for live-fire drills in the Bohai and Yellow Seas ([朝鮮日報中文版](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxPX0JhTXV4OGtzaWU4OHBHc0gyOTlLOVdPU2Vac2djOVNFSjJfV0VtVXJ5TXhHd21SSEhFQUg3Vnp2MmdWN3NrYTB3UmFRTnF5N2NsbG9hQWF3Z09pMUlZQjFiQVpVUXJDQURveXFMOXJBUjJzMW8yUEpkZkpUcWFaRmJ4UlJ1M3FfZzhJYnp3), [USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/28/joint-russian-chinese-navy-patrol-sails-near-japan)).
- **U.S. air defense stockpiles under strain** after recent fighting with Iran, with analysis warning of depleted inventories. The Pentagon may face hard choices on resupply ([Sun Sentinel](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9yZi1NNnd1bEpuR0V6VFJjNUNFYnJBdEFpNXJqRUhBU0ZqQ2VOY3hLOGlla1lXajFXU09odFl5ZXVZVU9vQy1TbE9nTmk0SFdkckRyWl9nSjRTNlVSUGxIM3laM1ZLWnZXWnc)).
- **Trump meets Netanyahu and Zelenskyy** separately at the White House, signaling diplomatic efforts to manage the cascading crises. Trump cited 'good' talks on Iran but reiterated strike threats ([ABC13](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQckxLYkJwbm5YQU0wbC1HWEgxWmFWeHJHeVBUZ3pLbzVPTHNBUUMxWlR1eFVnTmhnbTFpU19LaW1TM1BJV0pjVnA5WHlKVy1HbmppbV9zcVdsVzVUaDZ2Q3dqalliOF9IRDVaWFlhMHVzb2VxVkthWVZhcTJvVmNSXzBCN0xxUERkMXpCOWt6RVVxb2ktNEVkMA), [Express Tribune](https://news.google.)).
- **U.S. Navy force posture reshuffling**: The prized Ohio-class submarine USS Georgia is heading into retirement, while the carrier strike campaign against Iran is paused but the naval blockade continues. Congress also directed a torpedo inventory overhaul for a two-war strategy ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/sea/prized-ohio-class-guided-missile-submarine-uss-georgia-heading-into-retirement), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-torpedo-inventory-fy27-ndaa/)).
- **China's long-range nuclear missile arsenal continues to grow**, as detailed in a new guide. Combined with the PLA report to Congress, this underscores the strategic competition ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/nuclear/a-guide-to-chinas-growing-long-range-nuclear-missile-arsenal), [USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/28/report-to-congress-on-the-peoples-liberation-army-2)).

**Watch next**: The aftermath of Iran's missile attack will dominate headlines, with potential U.S. retaliatory strikes or diplomatic off-ramps. The merging of the Ukraine and Iran conflicts via the Caspian strike could widen the theater. China's trans-Median line incursions and South China Sea base expansion will keep the Indo-Pacific on edge. Monitor U.S. air defense stockpile replenishment decisions and any movement of carrier strike groups.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻呈现多重震荡：AI领域遭遇股市恐慌与安全信任危机，芯片股因投资者对AI回报的担忧而集体下滑，同时OpenAI遭遇的黑客攻击被MIT Technology Review评价为“可预见的”。超过1100名AI专家联名呼吁暂停前沿AI开发，而Andrew Ng的LearnVector却逆势上线，试图用AI重塑个性化学习。科技产品方面，美国FCC宣布禁止进口外国制造的人形机器人和电源逆变器，矛头直指中国；eBay为2019年血腥猪面具骚扰案支付5600万美元和解金，成为企业治理反面教材。汽车圈则冷暖不均：沙特王子5%持股令Lucid股价飙升25%，但特斯拉前经理指控FSD测试车是“滚动隐患”，百度Apollo Go同日登陆伦敦街头。社区动态中，经典游戏《半条命》被移植到Mac OS 9引发怀旧热潮，而Manim动画引擎的浏览器化则展示了WebGPU的潜力。

- [芯片股在美亚两地因AI焦虑重挫](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cly8zng43npo)，投资者对AI资本支出的可持续性产生怀疑。
- [OpenAI遭“可预见的”黑客攻击](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/28/1140868/the-download-openai-hack-ai-stock-sell-off/)，MIT Tech Review指出类似攻击早有先例。
- [1100+AI专家呼吁全球放缓前沿AI研发](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOMEVBRUw0UXM1cUNNcmMxSjhVRG9Ga2EtNHdZMElzNzVjT2VlamlLU21laVhsd1phb2xVamZYY2hvbEhmRWR2QjAyekJmN09TaFR2Yks3RXJoVnlGcjFhaEJSQ0hZLUQydk1mOV9vb1RqbDJkaHJVRTZCV1RLS0tkOFUtUDBhYTZrU0hBaUVJWnZyZGRzMHNLb1d4R1pfSnp3QnJGUjNZdkN1aFE)，安全恐慌后监管呼声再起。
- [美国禁止进口外国制造的人形机器人和电源逆变器](https://www.engadget.com/2225693/the-us-is-banning-foreign-made-humanoid-robots-and-power-inverters/)，旨在推动国内新兴技术生产。
- [eBay及前高管以5600万美元和解网络跟踪案](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/ebay-former-execs-pay-56m-to-settle-bloody-pig-mask-harassment-case/)，涉及活昆虫、血腥猪面具等骇人手段。
- [沙特王子Alwaleed披露5%持股，Lucid股价飙涨25%](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/saudi-prince-alwaleed-5-percent-lucid-stake-lcid/)，为资金紧张的电动汽车制造商注入强心针。
- [特斯拉FSD测试经理指控车辆为“滚动隐患”](https://www.engadget.com/2225645/tesla-full-self-driving-cars-were-rolling-hazards-fired-manager/)，新诉讼揭露安全员严重不足。
- [《半条命》被移植到Mac OS 9](https://mac-classic.com/news/half-life-ported-to-mac-os-9/)，在Hacker News上获得186点热度，引发经典系统复兴讨论。

**后续观察：** 今日新闻的底层暗线是“信任危机”——无论是市场对AI投资回报的不信任、监管层对AI安全的不信任、还是公众对自动驾驶与大型科技企业行为的不信任。下周需关注芯片股能否企稳、FCC机器人禁令的后续影响，以及OpenAI是否会公布更详细的安全整改措施。
tech.en:
The tech world is grappling with a potent mix of AI anxiety and strategic realignments. Chip stocks slid across US and Asian markets as jitters over the sustainability of AI spending and a major security scare at OpenAI rattled investors. Simultaneously, a wave of calls from AI experts and employees—including those at OpenAI and Anthropic—is urging a global slowdown in frontier development. In automotive, Lucid got a massive Saudi vote of confidence, while Baidu’s robotaxis began testing in London. On the policy front, the US announced a ban on foreign-made humanoid robots and power inverters, targeting China. The eBay cyberstalking saga concluded with a $56M settlement. Meanwhile, the Hacker News community celebrated a nostalgic Half-Life port to Mac OS 9 and new open-source tools for note-taking and animation.

- **AI market jitters** – Chip stocks fell on fears of overvaluation and a security incident at OpenAI (described as "unprecedented" by the company). Over 1,100 AI experts signed an open letter calling for a global slowdown, and staff at OpenAI and Anthropic urged the US to boost oversight. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cly8zng43npo) | [MIT Technology Review](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/28/1140868/the-download-openai-hack-ai-stock-sell-off/) | [The Straits Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPYmIzT3dZQzhqRElRd0VBSHQ0LThJYjlOM0tGUGZ5TzBBZFRybUVDandSZ0t3NGxoQ0NMMlNrYmkwNlZfWFdubmNqUEFFQ2xGRkFBS1lSUXNBYXh0Q05wRnhFbm42ejRYTnNibURpcVR0eUhxVXl6RHBzOUFCb3U1MVBTekVfRERPc01LRGtxRVlMRm40bC1xRTdhNS1GT2NWVkRMSXRGVjNlVGpmTEtwSjQ2MG0)
- **US bans foreign humanoid robots** – The FCC announced a ban on imports of advanced robotic devices and power inverters from foreign adversaries, notably China. The rule covers mobile humanoid and quadruped robots, aiming to boost domestic production. [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2225693/the-us-is-banning-foreign-made-humanoid-robots-and-power-inverters/) | [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/972259/us-foreign-robots-power-inverter-ban)
- **eBay pays $56M to settle cyberstalking case** – Three former eBay executives and the company settled with a Massachusetts journalist couple who were harassed with live insects, a bloody pig mask, and other threats in 2019. [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/judge-blocks-first-state-law-that-would-have-banned-prediction-markets/) | [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/972209/ebay-cyberstalking-harassment-settlement)
- **Lucid stock jumps 25% on Saudi prince stake** – Saudi billionaire Prince Alwaleed bin Talal disclosed a 5% passive stake in the cash-strapped EV maker, signaling continued Saudi support. [Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/saudi-prince-alwaleed-5-percent-lucid-stake-lcid/)
- **Baidu Apollo Go begins London robotaxi testing** – The Chinese company started road testing in London with both Uber and Freenow (Lyft), days after a fully driverless trial in Hong Kong. [Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/baidu-apollo-go-london-robotaxi-testing-uber-lyft/)
- **Tesla FSD manager sues, claims 'rolling hazards'** – A former Houston fleet manager filed a wrongful-termination lawsuit alleging that understaffed robotaxi operations made cars dangerous on public streets. [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2225645/tesla-full-self-driving-cars-were-rolling-hazards-fired-manager/) | [Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/tesla-self-driving-manager-rolling-hazards-lawsuit/)
- **Community highlights: Half-Life on Mac OS 9** – Hacker News lit up with a port of Half-Life to Mac OS 9 (186 points), alongside Show HN projects like Manim in the browser via WebGPU and an open-sourced note-taking app Hubble. [Hacker News](https://mac-classic.com/news/half-life-ported-to-mac-os-9/) | [Hacker News](https://www.hubble.md/) | [Hacker News](https://studio.academa.ai/)

**Watch next:** The AI security scare and the wave of regulatory calls could trigger policy shifts in the coming weeks. The US robot ban may escalate tech decoupling with China. In EVs, watch for Tesla's response to the lawsuit and whether Lucid can capitalize on the Saudi boost. Keep an eye on the Baidu robotaxi expansion into right-hand-drive markets.

sports.zh: 今日体育新闻焦点集中在足球转会市场的暗流涌动与CBA选秀的尘埃落定。欧洲足坛迎来齐达内执教法国队的重磅官宣，同时切尔西新帅阿隆索的季前赛首秀与利物浦、热刺的转会博弈也备受关注。国内篮球方面，CBA选秀大会落下帷幕，宋昕澔当选状元引发薪资与制度讨论。此外，虎扑社区热议詹姆斯下赛季仅领390万美元的对比梗，以及陕西球迷违规受罚事件。羽毛球板块暂无重大赛事动态。
sports.en:
Today's sports news is headlined by a flurry of major football developments: Zinedine Zidane finally takes the France managerial role, Xabi Alonso's Chelsea era begins with a dramatic four-striker narrative, and Italian football emerges from 16 days of chaos with Roberto Mancini at the helm. The transfer window heats up with Bradley Barcola verbally agreeing to Liverpool and Savinho open to a Tottenham move, while Celtic breaks its record for Danish striker Kasper Hogh. Off the pitch, FIFA's plan to seek private investment in the World Cup draws fierce criticism from UEFA and UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham. In Chinese basketball, the 2026 CBA Draft concluded with notable picks like Zhang Junsheng to Xinjiang, and discussions on draft reform intensify as European leagues position themselves as viable alternatives to the NBA. Community buzz circles LeBron James's surprisingly low $3.9M salary and a fine on Shaanxi football fans for throwing flares. Badminton, however, offers no competitive news today.

- Zidane ends five-year hiatus to coach France, with analysts questioning how he will harness the squad's star power. [Zidane waited for France](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c20dxgpjng3o)
- Xabi Alonso's first Chelsea match is defined by four strikers: one scores a hat-trick while another's future looks uncertain. [Alonso's first Chelsea match](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c1w13ddr4ejo)
- Italian football's crisis ends with Mancini's appointment, but resignations of Maldini and Leonardo leave lingering instability. [After 16 days of chaos](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cddj2m5m0p0o)
- Celtic signs Kasper Hogh from Bodo/Glimt for a club-record fee, signaling aggressive rebuilding. [Celtic record signing](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cwymjrm0xlwo)
- Transfer market moves: Bradley Barcola verbally agrees terms with Liverpool, but clubs remain apart on valuation; Savinho keen on Tottenham switch. [Barcola](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/czrj8ke23g3o), [Savinho](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2kqvkwz17o)
- FIFA's proposal to attract private investment for the World Cup draws sharp rebuke from UEFA and the UK Prime Minister. [Uefa and PM criticise](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c8xng9894z0o)
- 2026 CBA Draft sees Xinjiang select Zhang Junsheng 5th overall and Wang Yiwei in the second round; media calls for systemic reforms. [CBA draft](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE5jRUZUQzVyNFcxUk9LRmNWQ1Fza19Lb1V2MDRMekM3bENKaVRyZFlqOGszTGdZc2d2RWhCWGNtUk9jMkVLV3FLQ0dYc1dWNlpRbGt3cEMwdm1ZV0w2MVYyZFpLLTZLSUlkak1ZQkdRcw), [Draft reform](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPeU1mMVlUZGhDa1JKenNBV3Q0VXA4ZnhSamtYTDc1VDhDU1dlWmZINHl4Ui12VFdOOGgtZ2oxVFctazV5TnhFcGJaaWkyelJCckE3ZV9iRUdrbjktVTRLZGJOc0ZYT0FMT1BUM2pSYnM3b0xVbXUzR2NpLURzeGhPMEdOZkI)
- Community highlight: LeBron James's $3.9M salary next season is lower than dozens of players, sparking debate; Shaanxi football club fined for fan misconduct. [B/R salary list](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9QN0ZqUHI3WUxLcW45am8yVlJlWloxQmdESWlkR3F5cVRWcFhQZUVTM1hobjlvbXU1NEg4dGd1aTQ4T1dkUk9KOFpjWTI4ZXRaZGJoT2R3cTRoRlM0OExFbzRIMA), [Flare fine](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE5keHBkVC1hSjZWcXRlbkJjdjc3ZHNTX0U5MTAwOWppMGFqMElpTENuRjVweVdiYUhDX0NIdUY2S0JsdTFJQ05tamNCSlgzTDJQUWxKUEt3)

**Watch next:** The final weeks of the transfer window will be pivotal—will Liverpool bridge the valuation gap for Barcola? Can Tottenham land Savinho? Zidane's tactical imprint on France and Mancini's attempts to stabilise Italian football will unfold in the coming days. In China, CBA draft reform discussions (rookie rights, selection scope, pick structure) could reshape the league's talent pipeline, while European leagues' growing appeal may accelerate player outflows.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐新闻焦点：欧美方面，Noah Kahan公开抗议白宫未经授权使用其歌曲《American Cars》，引发艺人政治维权讨论；《Jumanji: Open World》发布预告片，确定12月11日上映，系列终章备受期待。日韩方面，演员Moon Geun Young宣布结婚，Jennie与Tame Impala合作曲《Dracula》在Billboard电台榜升至第2，创个人新高。中国方面，泰国娱乐公司GMM就中国女粉丝被工作人员打事件再次回应称双方已和解，王鹤棣第三次参加全明星赛抵达洛杉矶备战。微博社区内，宋亚轩素颜胡茬自拍破圈，张泽禹9秒高音封神现场引发热议。

- [Noah Kahan Slams White House for Using His Song in Trump Promo Video](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/noah-kahan-white-house-music-trump-video-1235600195/) — 歌手明确表示“从未授权”，三媒（Rolling Stone、Deadline、Hollywood Reporter）交叉报道，反映艺人政治立场维权趋势。
- [‘Jumanji: Open World’ Trailer Takes Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart Out of the Console](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/jumanji-open-world-trailer-dwayne-johnson-jack-black-hart-1236658662/) — 系列终章预告发布，12月11日北美上映，核心阵容回归。
- [Evan Rachel Wood Says She’s Not Returning for ‘Practical Magic 2’ Because It’s “Not Following the Book”](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/evan-rachel-wood-practical-magic-2-not-following-book-1236658715/) — 演员因剧本偏离原著而退出，引发续集创作争议。
- [Moon Geun Young Announces Marriage With Heartfelt Letter](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858223wpp/moon-geun-young-announces-marriage-with-heartfelt-letter) — 韩星文瑾莹与音乐剧演员结婚，手写信公开。
- [Jennie Hits New Peak Of No. 2 On Billboard Radio Songs Chart With Tame Impala Collab “Dracula”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858178wpp/jennie-hits-new-peak-of-no-2-on-billboard-radio-songs-chart-with-tame-impala-collab-dracula) — 韩流与欧美独立音乐合作再创佳绩。
- [泰国娱乐公司GMM再次回应“中国女粉丝被工作人员打”：双方达成和解](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTkFVX3lxTE9DcmlqdU1VUHRvbWNra2sxLVZuV0ZwUVpfZEdzbFJXSzlER1hzWXNyY3ZVTnlOdW1HRVBwcXBOZU1FZHVFaWR3TEFFOVdZdw) — 事件走向平息，但暴露海外娱乐服务管理漏洞。
- [宋亚轩素颜胡茬自拍，真实感破圈](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFA5emFOSVlnQ003T0IxMWVaRGlCWHQ5UTc4em5YSnozVnA4ZEtmX3RuX1RPd0xUSGloS2xpMk5hdFpCNnJyclF0c2RqWXNwcWpZNEE5YmxYemRjRFFPdzREd2RtUUVqT2haeTVSZVZ4QUc) — 偶像真实状态获网友好评。

**后续观察：** Noah Kahan事件可能推动音乐人更严格管理作品政治使用授权；《Jumanji》续集票房受预告反响直接影响，需关注首周数据。文瑾莹结婚与Jennie榜单成绩共同折射韩流艺人多元化发展。中国内娱短剧、综艺、全明星跨界持续活跃，GMM和解结果或影响中泰娱乐合作信任。
entertainment.en:
Today's entertainment landscape is marked by franchise expansions, political music disputes, and personal milestones in Asia. In Hollywood, the release of the 'Jumanji: Open World' trailer signals the end of a popular trilogy, while Noah Kahan's public condemnation of the White House using his song underscores the ongoing tension between artists and political entities. Meanwhile, the Korean entertainment industry buzzes with actor Moon Geun Young's marriage and new casting announcements, and the Chinese fan community reacts to a resolved incident involving Thai company GMM. Key themes include the push for unionization in VFX, sophomore slumps in streaming, and the growing influence of short-form content in China.

- [Pearl Jam’s Early Years Revealed in New Intimate Photography Book](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/pearl-jam-photography-book-jeff-ament-since-forever-1235600216/) — A new photography book by bassist Jeff Ament offers rare backstage and candid moments from the band's formative decades, appealing to longtime fans and music historians.
- [Evan Rachel Wood Says She’s Not Returning for ‘Practical Magic 2’ Because It’s “Not Following the Book”](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/evan-rachel-wood-practical-magic-2-not-following-book-1236658715/) — The actress expresses disappointment over creative deviations, highlighting the tension between source material and adaptation in legacy sequels.
- [Noah Kahan Calls Out Donald Trump’s Administration For Using “American Cars” Song In White House Social Media Post](https://deadline.com/2026/07/noah-kahan-donald-trump-american-cars-song-white-house-1237006368/) — A direct rebuke from the artist adds to a growing list of musicians objecting to unsanctioned political use of their work, raising questions about licensing and consent.
- [‘Jumanji: Open World’ Trailer Sees Core Four Group Of Videogame Avatars Unleashed In Real Life](https://deadline.com/2026/07/jumanji-3-open-world-trailer-dwayne-johnson-jack-black-1237006351/) — Sony drops the first full trailer for the franchise's finale, promising a meta twist where the avatars escape into the real world; set for December 2026 release.
- [Moon Geun Young Announces Marriage With Heartfelt Letter](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858223wpp/moon-geun-young-announces-marriage-with-heartfelt-letter) — The beloved Korean actress ties the knot with musical actor Jung Pyeong, drawing congratulations and nostalgic reactions from fans.
- [Jennie Hits New Peak Of No. 2 On Billboard Radio Songs Chart With Tame Impala Collab “Dracula”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858178wpp/jennie-hits-new-peak-of-no-2-on-billboard-radio-songs-chart-with-tame-impala-collab-dracula) — The BLACKPINK member continues her solo success, climbing to a career-high on US radio and signaling strong cross-over appeal.
- [泰国娱乐公司GMM再次回应“中国女粉丝被工作人员打”：双方达成和解，此前被暂时停职的工作人员已恢复原有工作职责](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTkFVX3lxTE9DcmlqdU1VUHRvbWNra2sxLVZuV0ZwUVpfZEdzbFJXSzlER1hzWXNyY3ZVTnlOdW1HRVBwcXBOZU1FZHVFaWR3TEFFOVdZdw) — After public outcry, GMM confirms a settlement with the Chinese fan, but the reinstatement of the employee has sparked further debate about accountability in fan-idol interactions.

Watch next for the official 'Jumanji: Open World' marketing rollout ahead of December, any further developments in artist-politics clashes, the trajectory of K-drama viewing figures particularly for Netflix sophomore seasons, and how the GMM incident reshapes Chinese fan community norms.

美股.zh:
美股市场整体承压，AI板块抛售潮未止，但苹果、福特等个别公司凭借业绩或差异化策略逆势上涨。中东战事推高油价，能源股走强；监管层动作频频，美联储推进内部改革，特朗普法律案及马斯克旗下xAI诉讼亦引发关注。

- **[SK海力士盈利翻倍仍遭抛售，AI期望过高成风险](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/sk-hynix-earnings-profit-revenue-hbm-memory.html)**：收入与利润翻倍增长，但未能满足华尔街对AI宠儿的极致预期，股价暴跌，拖累整个半导体板块。
- **[苹果成第二家5万亿美元公司，投资者逃离AI涌入硬件](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jul/28/apple-second-ever-5tn-company-as-investors-flee-ai-stocks)**：苹果凭借对AI军备竞赛的克制和产品涨价能力，吸引避险资金，市值突破5万亿美元。
- **[福特上调全年指引，Q2盈利超预期](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/ford-motor-f-earnings-q2-2026.html)**：福特受益于运营改善、定价韧性和高利润产品组合，宣布F系列卡车复苏计划进展顺利，股价盘后上涨。
- **[伊朗导弹袭击致油价飙升，能源板块震荡](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-iran-us-hormuz.html)**：伊朗突袭美军基地后，布伦特原油大幅上涨，沙特寻找替代出口路线，市场对供应中断的担忧升温。
- **[亚马逊、Meta、微软本周围绕资本支出面临投资者拷问](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/hyperscalers-face-higher-capex-scrutiny-after-alphabet-report-panned.html)**：谷歌财报显示自由现金流转负并提升资本支出，引发市场对超大规模云厂商回报率的担忧，投资者将密切关注本周科技巨头的财报电话会。

判断：AI交易正在经历去泡沫化的阵痛，但苹果、福特等非AI核心公司的强劲表现显示市场并非全面崩溃。中东地缘风险是短期最大变量，油价走势将直接影响通胀预期和联储政策。
美股.en:
U.S. equities face a tug-of-war between a deepening AI rout and bright spots in energy and industrial earnings. Apple’s $5tn milestone underscores a defensive rotation away from high-capex AI names, while Iran’s missile attack drove oil higher and revived geopolitical risk premiums. Ford’s earnings beat and raised guidance provided a lift for the auto sector, but the hyperscaler earnings season remains the dominant near-term catalyst.

- The AI sell-off spread to Asian tech bellwethers SK Hynix and SoftBank, but U.S. traders are bracing for similar scrutiny on Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft after Alphabet’s free cash flow turned negative ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/hyperscalers-face-higher-capex-scrutiny-after-alphabet-report-panned.html)).
- Apple hit a $5.04tn market cap as investors sought safety, partly because Apple is sitting out the AI spending race ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jul/28/apple-second-ever-5tn-company-as-investors-flee-ai-stocks)).
- Oil jumped on renewed U.S.-Iran hostilities, with Brent and WTI spiking after Iran’s ballistic missile attack on U.S. forces ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-iran-us-hormuz.html)).
- Ford raised its full-year guidance after a Q2 earnings beat, citing operational improvements and resilient F-Series demand ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/ford-motor-f-earnings-q2-2026.html)).
- Seagate’s earnings beat provided a rare bright spot for the AI trade in after-hours trading ([MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/seagates-earnings-are-welcome-news-for-the-battered-ai-trade-92dfc30f)).

**Signal**: Watch for further rotation out of AI hype into value and energy, but the hyperscaler reports this week will determine if the sell-off is a correction or a structural shift.

中国经济.zh:
中国资产在全球AI抛售中展现相对韧性，港股互联网逆市上涨，渣打银行利润创新高并启动回购。但A股存储芯片板块受海外冲击严重，光模块龙头以回购稳定信心。人民币国际化与香港经济前景成为关注焦点。

- **[港股互联网逆势走高，腾讯、美团等领涨](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/chip-selloff-sk-hynix-samsung-softbank.html)**：亚洲科技股普遍下跌，但香港上市中国互联网股票（腾讯、美团、百度、快手）全部上涨，显示资金从AI芯片转向消费互联网板块。
- **[渣打银行上半年利润增10%，启动10亿美元回购](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362209/standard-chartered-posts-10-rise-first-half-profit-launches-us1b-buy-back)**：净利创纪录达33.7亿美元，但中东冲突导致的减值损失抵消了财富管理收益，回购计划表明管理层对资本实力有信心。
- **[A股存储芯片暴跌6%，光模块巨头提议80亿元回购](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1BV1VZYTJqb1RUY1UybjVvakZ5MkROblY1ZFBuUk9EWnM5YlRyc0p3SHdFbHFVVjlsVWI3ajRBd05kTG1YcFkydlpQUVhUaVh3RUdzcjNHVWR4Z2ZHZjRGU3Zn)**：受海外AI芯片抛售传染，兆易创新跌停，但中际旭创董事长提议回购，释放低位信心信号。ETF资金昨日净流入253亿元，显示机构借机抄底。
- **[上海清算所推动离岸人民币扩张，瞄准全球增长](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3362189/shanghai-clearing-house-targets-global-growth-expanded-offshore-yuan-push)**：上清所所长马建阳撰文称将通过全球金融网络扩大离岸人民币池，巩固上海在衍生品清算中的主导地位，同时隔离国内风险。
- **[香港房价连涨13个月但涨幅放缓](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxPWFJTQzJpd1hYVjdFcGt4ODhxajd3MXkwS19mdk40WWwtaVJfUVFXaTVZMUF4aTlXMV8yQkM5SWllT1JYRmhOMEkwYTFvU3ZzcDNBV2xKNEJiSWtOMGFJZEFlUGlrWVJlQm5USVhTV2VpYjVzVGIzVDB1YWRqVTVqcExhN1FpYlhEMG5kRTgxOTNHOGF1NXprNXI5U3BBYjNEa1pyS2pRZjJpSlFWQWZremhHd1JCTm8)**：6月香港楼价继续上涨，但增速放缓至13个月来最低，高利率与地缘风险制约购买力。

判断：中国资产正从AI泡沫中分离，互联网、银行等传统板块成为避风港。人民币国际化提速和香港经济结构调整（AI出口拉动）是中长期主线，但短期仍需观察海外科技股抛售对A股情绪的溢出效应。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets saw a split between resilient Hong Kong-listed internet stocks and a sharp sell-off in A-share chip names, as the global AI rout hit local sentiment. Meanwhile, financial infrastructure and wealth management flows suggest medium-term confidence in China’s offshore yuan push and Hong Kong’s role. The day’s news also highlighted continued corporate real estate moves and robotics diversification.

- Standard Chartered reported a 10% profit rise to a record $3.37bn and announced a $1bn buyback, though a Middle East impairment charge weighed; the results underscore China-linked bank resilience ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362209/standard-chartered-posts-10-rise-first-half-profit-launches-us1b-buy-back)).
- Shanghai Clearing House is pushing an expanded offshore yuan model to boost international bond sales, aiming to solidify Shanghai’s derivatives clearing dominance ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3362189/shanghai-clearing-house-targets-global-growth-expanded-offshore-yuan-push)).
- A-share storage chip stocks plunged over 6%, with 240-billion-yuan GigaDevice hitting limit-down, reflecting global AI sector contagion ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1BV1VZYTJqb1RUY1UybjVvakZ5MkROblY1ZFBuUk9EWnM5YlRyc0p3SHdFbHFVVjlsVWI3ajRBd05kTG1YcFkydlpQUVhUaVh3RUdzcjNHVWR4Z2ZHZjRGU3Zn)).
- Hong Kong home prices extended gains for a 13th month in June, though the pace slowed, supporting property-linked stocks ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxPWFJTQzJpd1hYVjdFcGt4ODhxajd3MXkwS19mdk40WWwtaVJfUVFXaTVZMUF4aTlXMV8yQkM5SWllT1JYRmhOMEkwYTFvU3ZzcDNBV2xKNEJiSWtOMGFJZEFlUGlrWVJlQm5USVhTV2VpYjVzVGIzVDB1YWRqVTVqcExhN1FpYlhEMG5kRTgxOTNHOGF1NXprNXI5U3BBYjNEa1pyS2pRZjJpSlFWQWZremhHd1JCTm8)).
- HSBC is relocating its group chief people officer from London to Hong Kong, doubling down on its Asia pivot ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362190/hsbc-relocate-senior-executive-hong-kong-amid-pivot-asia-sources)).

**Signal**: The resilience of Hong Kong-listed Chinese internet stocks amid the AI rout is a key divergence to watch; if sustained, it could signal decoupling from the U.S. tech cycle.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲股市在企业财报提振下小幅走高，但中东战争的外溢效应成为最大隐患，惠誉报告指出伊朗冲突已拖累发达欧洲经济。欧央行按兵不动，市场聚焦周四欧元区GDP初值及9月加息信号。

- **[惠誉报告：伊朗战争溢出效应2026年拖累发达欧洲经济](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNSFNjSGhLeGJCb0ZOTWNqTjg0eE1HYkw2MkczVjVJajZiMXpEbVlYNEhwLUh6TXFlSENOclN4N1BWLXdsTi1OZzlKcUdOMEptZFhzc2JhM2pFcTRUeDJWaFkwWXdyNGRkaTVnbkNZb0tyOHFRWEpScDBkd2xqN25BWGpHUVQydVZKZzF1WVRSbWJCdw)**：评级机构指出，能源价格飙升、供应链中断及信心下滑正在冲击欧洲，尤其依赖中东石油和航运的德国、意大利等国。
- **[欧洲股市小幅上涨，企业盈利抵消利率担忧](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxPUTVfSGdfbzFLVDZpVVpEU2ZRaVJnNXU3S0NIYktLTmtLUXUxc05tQjhDbDV2Zmxfc0lkTm94UGk2enBVSjh4Xzg4RnNmWGF0RU01N3I2YUlyQVBGMzN1OEJ1TnFBOFh0eE9jbGVLYW53aFgxMldrdzhaYTdfOUxEZkhfTmJCSHRVV2FN)**：DAX、CAC、FTSE100均收高，但投资者对欧央行9月加息路径保持谨慎，周四将公布的欧元区GDP初值成为关键指引。
- **[联合利华警告未来数月继续涨价](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/28/marmite-dove-unilever-price-rises-costs-world-cup)**：这家消费品巨头表示，成本上升将迫使旗下品牌（如Marmite、多芬）进一步提价，世界杯营销推动二季度销售增长，但涨价压力预示着欧洲通胀粘性。
- **[欧洲房地产市场稳定复苏，投资者更趋选择性](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE44TnQ2cFRzdGp1SGdFWXNtTzV4dnRWQjFLTm9LMXZiLVJvZ3p2TW5CbUEtbFVEMHFuakZZbXZIaWh2bmJDUm1LQjc3amMtMzhkd3FaN1hlcVVLXy1BMjVxUDRIMG1xa2J5eTBsejZFbXA0Tm0zVW5mTEJBNjQ2dw)**：Cushman & Wakefield报告显示，欧洲商业地产交易温和回暖，但投资者聚焦核心资产，对二线城市保持谨慎。
- **[欧央行扩大气候因素在抵押品框架中的应用](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260724_4~f082ce289d.en.html)**：欧央行宣布将气候风险因素纳入非金融企业信用债抵押品评估，标志着绿色金融监管进一步深化，可能提高高碳企业融资成本。

判断：欧洲处于“财报亮眼但宏观阴影加大”的夹缝中——中东冲突推高能源成本，进而侵蚀企业利润和消费者购买力。欧央行9月是否加息将取决于周四GDP数据和油价走势。
欧洲经济.en:
European equities edged higher supported by robust corporate earnings, but the macroeconomic backdrop is clouded by the Iran conflict and its spillover effects on trade and energy. The ECB is preparing for a potential September rate hike, with the flash Q2 GDP reading critical. Consumer goods giant Unilever warned of further price increases, adding to inflation concerns.

- Fitch released a report warning that Iran war spillovers are straining developed Europe’s economy in 2026, highlighting supply chain and energy cost risks ([IndexBox](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNSFNjSGhLeGJCb0ZOTWNqTjg0eE1HYkw2MkczVjVJajZiMXpEbVlYNEhwLUh6TXFlSENOclN4N1BWLXdsTi1OZzlKcUdOMEptZFhzc2JhM2pFcTRUeDJWaFkwWXdyNGRkaTVnbkNZb0tyOHFRWEpScDBkd2xqN25BWGpHUVQydVZKZzF1WVRSbWJCdw)).
- Unilever warned it will push through further price rises over coming months to offset rising costs, though strong World Cup marketing boosted sales in Q2 ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/28/marmite-dove-unilever-price-rises-costs-world-cup)).
- European stocks ended modestly higher as strong corporate earnings offset interest rate concerns; the DAX, CAC, and FTSE 100 all edged up ([Yahoo Finance UK](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxPUTVfSGdfbzFLVDZpVVpEU2ZRaVJnNXU3S0NIYktLTmtLUXUxc05tQjhDbDV2Zmxfc0lkTm94UGk2enBVSjh4Xzg4RnNmWGF0RU01N3I2YUlyQVBGMzN1OEJ1TnFBOFh0eE9jbGVLYW53aFgxMldrdzhaYTdfOUxEZkhfTmJCSHRVV2FN)).
- The ECB extended the use of climate factors in its collateral framework to non-financial corporate credit claims, a step toward greening monetary policy ([ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260724_4~f082ce289d.en.html)).
- European real estate markets continue a stable recovery, with investors adopting a more selective approach, according to Cushman & Wakefield ([Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE44TnQ2cFRzdGp1SGdFWXNtTzV4dnRWQjFLTm9LMXZiLVJvZ3p2TW5CbUEtbFVEMHFuakZZbXZIaWh2bmJDUm1LQjc3amMtMzhkd3FaN1hlcVVLXy1BMjVxUDRIMG1xa2J5eTBsejZFbXA0Tm0zVW5mTEJBNjQ2dw)).

**Signal**: Thursday’s Eurozone GDP flash will be pivotal; weaker-than-expected growth could tilt the ECB toward a hold, while strong data would keep a September hike firmly on the table.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
同花顺社区热点聚焦A股结构性行情：存储芯片暴跌引发恐慌，资金转向汽车ETF和政策受益板块；地产与机器人概念受关注，ETF资金逆势净流入显示机构态度。

- **[A股存储芯片跳水超6%，2400亿兆易创新跌停](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1BV1VZYTJqb1RUY1UybjVvakZ5MkROblY1ZFBuUk9EWnM5YlRyc0p3SHdFbHFVVjlsVWI3ajRBd05kTG1YcFkydlpQUVhUaVh3RUdzcjNHVWR4Z2ZHZjRGU3Zn)**：受海外AI芯片股暴跌冲击，A股存储芯片板块单日重挫，市值超2400亿的兆易创新跌停，但长鑫科技逆势涨1.6%，体现国产替代分化。
- **[港股通汽车ETF领涨6.57%，半导体设备ETF领跌7.62%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE4zd3RDVW5hZFhCZmI4YXhSY3NINU1zdS1QYld5QnZ4TkFlMFNKdFdkeVRnZzFQb3dUT09YQ0VuMHJ3OGtEQ0pPNU5wRVJOMTJuXzV2M3NtaDdOSHpJaWZyeg)**：ETF午评显示资金从半导体设备大幅流出，转向汽车主题，反映了市场对AI硬件过剩的担忧与新能源车消费刺激预期的博弈。
- **[A股万亿光模块巨头，董事长提议最多80亿元回购](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFBRSUpRaEVnc0h6ZmlLbWFIRWtiNVBDWWJiV0Zub3VOWDNCMzVoUmNmLV84VlpiRU5qVU42RTNYTmFCc29nWjlGbjNYQURQbjA5b0ozVVdDZlRXTm5MRzNXZw)**：中际旭创（市值超万亿）董事长提议大规模回购，意在稳定市场信心，此前光模块板块因AI出口受限传闻承压。
- **[凡拓数创在北京成立具身智能科技公司](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9zSkNRVEVlOGxZTEVtYWhMeVZFZjJCTGZiaGptQTRyR3FCdUlwamttYjNibmdEVTZ6anUxek42dVd6QlFHaTBMUmlGQTZuTGN2ZnBadkEwU3ZwN1ZkNzBWRnlR)**：A股公司跨界布局具身智能，显示资本与政策驱动下机器人赛道持续升温，与特朗普禁止中国产人形机器人形成张力。
- **[昨日ETF资金整体净流入253.31亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE56c19JckNPMktTRXIxQjBJRWhvM0ctM2FDMXJuZGJwNnhxRFM0dXB4M3pRNGZaRTB1dUp3bVV3NmhKWXV6VXBiTm9tb2JWcFh1YnB0QXFCaHZqNW8tSUE)**：尽管市场调整，ETF仍获大规模净申购，沪深300、科创50等宽基指数ETF为主要流入方向，反映机构资金逢低布局。

判断：同花顺社区情绪在恐慌与抄底间摇摆，存储芯片的暴跌是海外AI风险传导的缩影，而汽车ETF和回购公告显示市场仍在寻找结构性机会。军工、机器人等主题可能成为下一个博弈点。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investors on the Tonghuashun community focused on the sharp sell-off in storage chip stocks while also tracking flows into ETFs and new ventures in robotics and aerospace. Sentiment was mixed: heavy losses in popular AI-themed names contrasted with bullish capital allocation moves and steady real estate data.

- A-share storage chip sector plunged over 6%, with 240-billion-yuan GigaDevice hitting limit-down; the community saw widespread discussion about the AI trade’s sustainability ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1BV1VZYTJqb1RUY1UybjVvakZ5MkROblY1ZFBuUk9EWnM5YlRyc0p3SHdFbHFVVjlsVWI3ajRBd05kTG1YcFkydlpQUVhUaVh3RUdzcjNHVWR4Z2ZHZjRGU3Zn)).
- Chaoyue Shares established a new subsidiary involved in rocket engine R&D, signaling increased corporate interest in aerospace beyond the chip sector ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5GcHFYQU1DVnRhLXRWOFM2V0NwRl96RVhLQmpEUExUQmVEUktqTENnRmpVd3ZXUE5NVzZBVVV2ay00bWZIWEtRVFJYSDUza18xZE1KNngwRFdQSVRlMHZPZHJ3)).
- China Merchants Shekou increased the registered capital of its Beijing unit to 23.5 billion yuan, a sign of continued expansion in the real estate sector ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBVWFg4NGwzZWxlZklPX2pqay1vbzVzWlNRU0ZRY3RxMmg3dks3SkFnY21EVlFDdVBrc0trYzA0MjNyZF9OcU52QWJqeHV3ZFFJVllIT2NSYjl1OGVOVkU3T1dB)).
- Beijing’s property transaction data showed 206 new home and 651 second-hand home signings on July 28, providing a modestly positive read for the housing market ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBCMHR2ZlRGRFY5bmNENzBNcDh6WDRzUnJxWDVTTFdtS1I3T1dnd0xYdDFHNFI3aWQtdUhremJGaTRMUzdJeml6QVNoVVZKRHkyQ01hZHJha1BCVUpNOEVjOUZB)).
- ETF funds saw a net inflow of 25.331 billion yuan yesterday, reflecting institutional buying on dips despite the broader market weakness ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE56c19JckNPMktTRXIxQjBJRWhvM0ctM2FDMXJuZGJwNnhxRFM0dXB4M3pRNGZaRTB1dUp3bVV3NmhKWXV6VXBiTm9tb2JWcFh1YnB0QXFCaHZqNW8tSUE)).

**Signal**: The robust ETF inflows amid the chip rout suggest retail and institutional investors are positioning for a rebound, but the storage chip sector’s volatility remains the primary source of anxiety in the community.

欧美.zh:
美伊短暂停火后迅速破裂，伊朗向驻约旦美军发射导弹，美军拦截成功，但双方对抗烈度上升。以色列在加沙杀死一名巴勒斯坦人并摧毁清真寺，西岸定居者袭击家庭。美国西雅图美食节枪击案3人遇难，社区哀悼。法国野火在热浪下复燃，消防员全力应对。
- [伊朗导弹射向驻约旦美军，停火仅五天即告终结](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/29/iran-missiles-target-us-forces-in-jordan-after-a-five-day-pause-in-war)
- [以色列在加沙行动升级，摧毁清真寺](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/29/israel-kills-palestinian-destroys-mosque-in-gaza)
- [西雅图枪击案受害者身份公布，家属悲痛](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgv7m5z4n0o)
- [巴黎西南部野火因40℃热浪复燃](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yd8gly1ydo)
- [日本地震死亡13人——欧美媒体广泛报道](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/29/japan-earthquake-death-aftershocks)

中东冲突与极端天气的双重冲击正在考验欧美应急与外交能力，后续关注伊朗是否继续反击。
欧美.en:
The desk was dominated by renewed military confrontation between Iran and the US, with Iranian ballistic missiles targeting US forces in Jordan after a five-day lull. US Central Command confirmed successful interceptions, but the attacks signal Tehran's willingness to test Washington's defenses. In parallel, joint US-Saudi strikes on Iran-backed groups in Iraq widen the conflict geography. Meanwhile, notable developments include Netanyahu's upcoming meeting with Trump, a fatal shooting at a Seattle food festival, and the ongoing fallout from the Idaho student murders trial.

- **[Iran and US trade strikes](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c70g6y24d76o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** and **[US forces in Jordan targeted](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/29/iran-missiles-target-us-forces-in-jordan-after-a-five-day-pause-in-war?traffic_source=rss)** – The end of a brief pause in Iran-US hostilities. Al Jazeera and BBC both report the strikes; implications for broader Middle East stability are severe.
- **[Netanyahu to meet Trump](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/28/g-s1-135833/trump-netanyahu-iran-war)** – The first face-to-face since the Iran war began. Both leaders have political incentives to project strength; expect decisions on escalatory or de-escalatory steps.
- **[US walks out of UN Security Council meeting](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c87nj3w9gxjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** – A diplomatic row after the US joined North Korea and Russia in opposing extension of the UN human rights chief's term; this isolates Washington further on multilateral platforms.
- **[Seattle food festival shooting](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgv7m5z4n0o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** – Three killed; community mourning. The incident underscores ongoing gun violence in the US.
- **[Wildfires in France](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yd8gly1ydo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** – A new 40°C heatwave threatens to reignite efforts in Gironde, highlighting climate risks.

The key signal to watch: whether the Iran missile strike is a one-off or the start of a sustained campaign. Escalation could draw in Gulf states and affect oil markets.

日韩.zh:
日本九州熊本县发生震度7地震，死亡13人，数百人受伤，数千人被迫疏散。韩国股市暴跌近11%，芯片股领跌，SK海力士虽创纪录利润仍未能阻止抛售。AI摄像头在首尔发现自杀企图引发讨论。著名作家东野圭吾去世。

- [东野圭吾逝世，享年68岁](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/07/28/national/keigo-higashino-dies/)

日本救灾与韩国金融市场动荡成为今日东亚核心议题，两国政策应对将直接影响区域稳定。
日韩.en:
A major earthquake on Japan's Kyushu island (magnitude 6.8, intensity 7 on the shindo scale) has killed at least 13, injured hundreds, and left tens of thousands without water and power. Rescue operations are ongoing amid building collapses and a mall explosion. In financial markets, South Korea's KOSPI plunged nearly 11% in a single session, triggering circuit breakers, as investors dumped chipmaker shares—including SK hynix despite its record Q2 profit—over fears of peaking AI memory demand.

- **[Japan earthquake death toll rises](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/29/japan-earthquake-death-aftershocks)** – Military mobilization underway; the quake struck Kyushu, a semiconductor manufacturing hub, which could disrupt supply chains. (Confirmed by [BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE8tM05BYy1OeVI5OVpLcFJjYzYzZlRTZ2o5eGozVDUwa3hRV2tqMDA0c1p3V0M2ajNoaXpWRHR2VWhRX2JpNl9ORHBmQTNvTEdSM2xoR2NCQTdrdw) and [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQREx4N194TTNIVm1ocmk3TEpxZ3hPSVpKQ2dwdEpuOTZNVXNsWVNjX1pjSGhkTHh6M01iWFZQeENTQ09KTHNQSzl0TzdwWGJqN2lrMmV2Vng4Z19ISUZWM1l3NXU1U2ptMENYZVRqSzd5Y0pLelAtOHJHZ19jbm5IdXhmYjhuekNDLW9aV1BvQUtUTTlLOWZhemRNSF81MS1LSXYybms2UGliMzhHaW14SW52V2ZOZw))
- **[South Korea's Kospi sinks nearly 11%](https://news.google.)** – Heavy selling of chipmakers, including SK hynix, which earlier reported record Q2 profit. The crash suggests the market is pricing in a downturn in AI memory after the recent boom.
- **[AI cameras spot suicide attempts in Seoul](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxNRmZuNWN5MXFTUDNKRmZweTV2LUpEV25PaUpjNjF2T0IwYTN6SHFPT3paT1RDTVhQM3Z5UGwwNDN4Q2JkemxSeWdnbWFMXzQ4aEFlbU83NDBPM1c0YmNNV1dRTDFLT0tic1ZHVFVtcTlBZlU0QlZJMXYtVWZsTlFpRS02M1FMOUwyRUF3YmxXZ1RSWnFIVC1UYUNR)** – A notable social technology deployment: AI cameras in the capital detect suicide attempts, raising privacy and effectiveness debates.
- **[ICC president seeks Japan's aid to counter Trump push](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE81X0UzRXJJakxDa0huQ3JNcXNmOXMtNmxmYUpBN0hKSzB2Qjh6c3Mtd0RmaDY4LVJtLWh6STBOR05ITFB0eGtNdmd4b2dzdG04VmJZbk1aa1NjTXZmRWtjRjQ3azFRcjdhSldnUU10WndzcklSZzRJYVZXZndOX3c)** – Geopolitical undercurrent: International Criminal Court asks Tokyo to resist Washington's pressure on Asian member withdrawals.

The Japan earthquake could disrupt semiconductor supply lines; the KOSPI crash may force BOK or government intervention. Both stories have immediate cross-border economic consequences.

中国.zh:
国内新闻以教育、经济与社会发展为主：教育部启动高等教育数字化研讨班；中国医疗队在阿尔及利亚义诊；新疆数字化发展报告引关注；中央宣传部授予王戟“时代楷模”称号；《中国农村发展报告2026》发布。此外，BBC回顾1976唐山地震对中国半个世纪的影响。

中国社会在平稳推进数字化与民生保障的同时，也通过海外医疗援助展现大国责任，内部治理与对外叙事同步展开。
中国.en:
China's news cycle today was dominated by positive domestic narratives: the Ministry of Propaganda awarded the 'Model of the Times' title to a PLA soldier, and various official media outlets highlighted economic stability, education reforms, and social development. The 'China Economic Roundtable' focused on H1 2026 GDP data, while tax big data was used to showcase growth signals. A notable retrospective piece from BBC China explored how the 1976 Tangshan earthquake reshaped the country's disaster response.

- **[中央宣传部授予王戟同志“时代楷模”称号](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBhOGRRRXdDMU83bUsxNW9jZWNUekFXUXd1YXV3TlhqbG9yYjBpLUVFY2x5dDZ6bVNVLUo0bFVaMzZ2bDZqNEthYTRqOVhNb2RUUG03TGFMME9odVJsbUhpSVFKUndJd0l6OEhxNzFXdGVZV0pXY0RmcktmWlVCZw)** – A standard recognition of individual sacrifice; reinforces state messaging on dedication and patriotism.
- **[“中国经济圆桌会”聚焦2026年中国经济半年报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQekt5QlJtSHNEanJPazAyZndTajl3cVV5RkZfc1VrOGRRM1dqd2UxVWItT1YxWEYwcHJCcmtJR0dTa2ZxcWI5ckpwRlNSakIzbUluMmRwaUNKa1lkRmE1bWZYTzNlVTVLZVIweFVteS13M0dwbjB6T3NyQ0xhbWNMYW0yT3A5QXR2)** – Official narrative focuses on steady recovery; watch for any deviation from target growth.
- **[从税收大数据看上半年经济运行亮点](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPUy1uR1VBUFRPVnJwVUNUYl94WWFVNmFaS3Fqa243czkwYmhrajZNT1o5T0RIblBnM0xMRTk5aHFYT0hZRXhuaExsX3hodzBjc2hrQnVyLWhKZU5QT3RmcUhfdUsydWhxTDBpWEZkRmdmLXJvSl9TN2FpcnM5d2dUbl9uanl6em5h)** – Tax data used to show consumption and industry uptick; a proxy for economic health.
- **[重回1976唐山地震：如何改变中国半个世纪？](https://news.google.)** – BBC’s retrospective on the 1976 Tangshan earthquake frames it as a turning point in China's emergency management and societal resilience.
- **[藤森庆子宣誓就任秘鲁总统](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE0wQ0N1RHRodWd4WU9jTEZpTUttbVpySDR2SDhjRDRlUDJyR2lBZ0QwaXFYdG9VRERaRFQ5WEczeTg2emFKUXpsczRjSkFqVjVMVWJ1SnctNklGM0htcjBaQ0pWZHhkZW5GMGZXQmF5dmZIYTI2cHVhdWNWOEh2Zw)** – Fujimori's inauguration in Peru; China likely watches for Belt and Road implications.

Domestic stability messaging persists, but the lack of independent reporting limits depth. The Tangshan piece is the most analytically valuable for understanding China's disaster governance evolution.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎今日动态包括公司回购股份、举办人文季活动，以及社区内关于名人争议、新疆话题的讨论。知乎-W于7月28日回购注销648.92万股，并转换部分普通股，显示管理层对股价的信心。人文季以“本来就很棒的人类”为主题，意在重拾人文关怀。社区内曾批王虹、邓煜水平低的网友因尴尬销号，另有毕业声称新疆农大强迫劳动等敏感内容被转载。
