知乎在强化资本运作与品牌建设的同时，仍需应对社区争议与外部信息监管的挑战。
知乎社区动态.en:
Zhihu's community dynamics today feature corporate actions (share buybacks and conversions), a controversy over a user deleting an account after criticizing prominent figures, and promotion of the 'Humanities Season' initiative. The platform continues to navigate between its role as a knowledge hub and the pressures of content moderation and financial restructuring.

- **[曾批王虹、邓煜水平低 一知乎网友疑因尴尬销号](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE9hTWd4VnVVbk5uZFNOaHFrNWozNHZJVlF3RGpkZk42UEJETjNfV3FCVjc3bGI2U21CdUh5NmRYY18wcVY0SG1hNlZZbw)** – A user who criticized two well-known figures, Wang Hong and Deng Yu, reportedly deactivated their account after facing backlash. The incident highlights the platform's intense internal debates and the personal risks of public critique.
- **[知乎：7月28日回购注销股份648.92万股并转换部分普通股](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTFBmZEhJb2J0aGYtZU8yXzZnOWJ4Z2dxWXFfbm8ybG4wMDkzMi1id0cwWExnUE5lWDJpQXJiMkpFUldjNE5nMUctNW16VnJpd3c2aHc)** – Zhihu executed a buyback and conversion of shares, a financial maneuver to support stock price and adjust capital structure. This is the second report (duplicate source) on the same event.
- **[在科技浪潮中重拾人文关怀，知乎人文季致敬“本来就很棒的人类”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNYzJOZTR1c3QwSnlpRTBldnpBMkpDVHV1aG9SYVV1S1RXX09WYmplX3pBVUJpbEV3OXpoZWdLSUlfZXZDQnktdkFzMDY1ZWFwZWxWTUluN3g2bzdhR05zeHZkWXk5SEQxUllHUmd5dkpfUUNwZGJ2M21pRjRGQ25pdG5DeVFQWHgtMC1jRw)** – Zhihu's Humanities Season campaign aims to re-center humanism amid tech discussions; reflects the platform's attempt to differentiate from purely algorithmic content.
- **[畢業生曝新疆農大強迫勞動 學生淪廉價勞工](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5BRUdrbmFwV1FEajJwdWFOeGN5dHlfcGNmSHJYa2FDLUZ2OTNuVTVtNUFrSkd5VUpxamJZN1pOSlVhT2hPTEJHeXJmSjBta3JMdnJmTTFnUnlQd9IBVEFVX3lxTE1IeEh3VW4xNlZlYzZ0cjl0RklKWG53QXFaYk1GZktjRUNsX1VNNzBWSkd1b0hVaWdpajhXLW9fZlV3c0hJcF9vWWZMWGNHTk1HejNLTw)** – A controversial post alleging forced labor at Xinjiang Agricultural University. The link source ('test.qycz.org') is non-mainstream and should be treated with skepticism; likely flagged by Zhihu moderation.

Zhihu remains a battleground for both intellectual discourse and censorship. The buyback signals management's belief in the company's undervaluation, while the user account deletion incident underscores community tensions.

国际安全.zh:
**概览：** 过去24小时，国际安全焦点集中在伊朗对美军的导弹突袭、美国防空库存告急以及美军与阿联酋成立首个AI联合任务组。以下为关键研判：

- **伊朗突袭美军，库存承压：** 伊朗发射弹道导弹攻击中东美军，[WSJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQYm1mNVNLLVJxQ012SmI5ejdTQlRnZzVXRVpzWFdkMnVLMEVPN2Etby1FUmNDZzViOGo0SFhWU21lYkFaZzVRVlFRZ3pqUGN2S1dUZWVDb2V2T2pSTjhNOTF4dHpOZl9MdUlib0tPQmNEeFpoV2hxRjRBSXlZMW1sTk5FbkxaSk5ybUNKdHdtYjdFenh1OFdCT054R3lxNEE)与[BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5FSzhZbndQb2lHQ1lnZ3FRaHdYZ1FLVGMzM1AxdnFvWWE3cW9FQW1CYlBYOGxrTnVJdXJCbXloU2V1b29xS0w0dHZYMFlNaGN2bUtxNUZ1ZXdJZw)均有报道。分析[Sun Sentinel](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9yZi1NNnd1bEpuR0V6VFJjNUNFYnJBdEFpNXJqRUhBU0ZqQ2VOY3hLOGlla1lXajFXU09odFl5ZXVZVU9vQy1TbE9nTmk0SFdkckRyWl9nSjRTNlVSUGxIM3laM1ZLWnZXWnc)指出关键防空弹药库存已接近极限。
- **美韩防空演练与阿联酋AI合作：** 美韩完成第7届联合防空导弹学院课程，[pacaf.af.mil](https://news.google.)美军中央司令部与阿联酋成立“Talon Synapse”AI联合任务组，[DefenseScoop](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNY0QwN1dIUVRycGd2cEhHQTUzVnNGMkNHUENJNlA2Yk1EU2h2ek0ySWtIZTNQdE96enE5X0x4Z2dFNkhDWnBLeHBIZGpMYTJELXpoNEZhN2s0UFBrR3Btb0tiYWEwUWtHUnFSNUZwdzNqb2NRNWljLTA3Wm5xYlM1NzhxM0tqVjlYaDdV)标志美军加速在盟友中推广AI作战能力。
- **美军伤员记录与航母态势：** 新解密的记录显示美军在伊朗冲突中遭受弹片、骨折和头部创伤等伤情，[Stars and Stripes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxOR3VpX09vcVNaM09INkxYQ0ZKRWFZY0doWHgxU1dLNkg5UzktblpLdjJENEY2Zk1UUi00S3hUWnE2Y01uYzZMU2ZZNlpUSndyWjdjVHpNTGhxWXBQZS1XalJWbmJ6WE9mR255Q3lQOFVxOGFZVkNWamFOcVFfalowaUNXVXlCdXN4T0NRdEtVYXF4SmhfRHQwSVZFSHRadGg1eGc)美航母位置报告[TWZ](https://www.twz.com/sea/where-are-the-aircraft-carriers-july-28-2026)显示海上封锁未松动。

**收束：** 伊朗突袭暴露美军防空弹药短板，阿联酋AI合作则显示美国积极寻求技术联盟弥补兵力漏洞。
国际安全.en:
The 国际安全 desk is dominated by Iran's surprise ballistic missile attack on U.S. forces in the Middle East, which has drawn down critical air defense stockpiles and forced the U.S. military to reassess its posture. Other major developments include the retirement of the Ohio-class submarine USS Georgia, the U.S.-South Korea air and missile defense academy, and new bilateral AI task forces. 
- [Iran Launches Surprise Missile Attack on U.S. Forces](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQYm1mNVNLLVJxQ012SmI5ejdTQlRnZzVXRVpzWFdkMnVLMEVPN2Etby1FUmNDZzViOGo0SFhWU21lYkFaZzVRVlFRZ3pqUGN2S1dUZWVDb2V2T2pSTjhNOTF4dHpOZl9MdUlib0tPQmNEeFpoV2hxRjRBSXlZMW1sTk5FbkxaSk5ybUNKdHdtYjdFenh1OFdCT054R3lxNEE): Multiple ballistic missiles targeted American troops; Pentagon confirms.
- [Air defense stockpiles near limit](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxPY3VDeTBxdk5wVkV3WXBWNndBSnl6VGpTbWN6WVhqN3pHaGN6cWs4V1NFOXhQX0g5V0RHVGRMNnMtSThtYlJyRkVuSnJKUENvaTFQeWFzbE9LTFNkVnNkdWNHUXlCSnlmdWx4aGJ0TFREVjBvbF9XTmZPWW1xYVk3cW1YWUo5MlV5MEl4RThvQklzM0FoVEN3MnZDZmdFVXhxTHRaY2lfV3VFVkw1cEgzZVRub1JRNVBRaHVlNE9zLTN4MmxpenhV): Analysis warns stockpiles are critically low after recent engagements.
- [USS Georgia heading into retirement](https://www.twz.com/sea/prized-ohio-class-guided-missile-submarine-uss-georgia-heading-into-retirement): All Ohio-class submarines to be retired within three years, impacting strike capability.
- [US-UAE AI task force formed](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNY0QwN1dIUVRycGd2cEhHQTUzVnNGMkNHUENJNlA2Yk1EU2h2ek0ySWtIZTNQdE96enE5X0x4Z2dFNkhDWnBLeHBIZGpMYTJELXpoNEZhN2s0UFBrR3Btb0tiYWEwUWtHUnFSNUZwdzNqb2NRNWljLTA3Wm5xYlM1NzhxM0tqVjlYaDdV): Task Force Talon Synapse aims to boost military AI applications in CENTCOM.
- [US troops wounded in Iran war documented](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxOR3VpX09vcVNaM09INkxYQ0ZKRWFZY0doWHgxU1dLNkg5UzktblpLdjJENEY2Zk1UUi00S3hUWnE2Y01uYzZMU2ZZNlpUSndyWjdjVHpNTGhxWXBQZS1XalJWbmJ6WE9mR255Q3lQOFVxOGFZVkNWamFOcVFfalowaUNXVXlCdXN4T0NRdEtVYXF4SmhfRHQwSVZFSHRadGg1eGc): New records reveal shrapnel, broken bones, and head trauma from the conflict.
**Signal**: The U.S. is simultaneously facing a fresh Iranian attack, depleted munitions, and the looming loss of a key submarine platform—this convergence will test the Pentagon's ability to sustain operations across theaters.

冲突局势.zh:
**概览：** 伊朗与乌克兰冲突在里海交汇，两场战争加速融合；特朗普暂停攻击但威胁不减，红海与非洲之角成为新风险点。

- **乌克兰打击伊朗船只，冲突扩散：** 乌克兰袭击里海上的伊朗船只，导致一名水手死亡，伊朗谴责并威胁报复。[NYT](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxOdjB0cGJvaWsyd04zZFBHc1FERzZzb2NqQmx4YXB5amtxek5rQ05iRENiWG5xeXo3UnBJTzhsbzgtWUtLamJlMXpyem9wblZ0MDdQMklLdy1XalNyRVlpdVltRU5tZkc5ZDdkRmZ1Y28tOW1NWEE4MXhBbDBWaWxQb3o1TkR0WTdTZ1dSeW9hOXA5SWNm)与[RFERL](https://news.google.)指出事情“更混乱”。
- **两场战争融合，特朗普面临抉择：** [Newsweek](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOTUhRLVV6Z0J0VmFmZ3hEYTB5UDdoeTBKb2NCSDNPWnZNNW9qRWZUYVFlNUVUQlR4cHVtcWl3QkkyYVVSR3dCaEdWY0dReFBNQ29MVTZNUjZILUI0azlzUkstbm1wbnJZaFQwNXhVdGdabkVDTUtjcVdGajg0V29uMmFiZHZNRi01elN4NA)分析称乌克兰战争与伊朗战争正在“合并”成单一大危机，特朗普在华盛顿分别会见内塔尼亚胡和泽连斯基，[ABC13](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQckxLYkJwbm5YQU0wbC1HWEgxWmFWeHJHeVBUZ3pLbzVPTHNBUUMxWlR1eFVnTmhnbTFpU19LaW1TM1BJV0pjVnA5WHlKVy1HbmppbV9zcVdsVzVUaDZ2Q3dqalliOF9IRDVaWFlhMHVzb2VxVkthWVZhcTJvVmNSXzBCN0xxUERkMXpCOWt6RVVxb2ktNEVkMA)但[The Guardian](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxQS3NoUEVwZmd3bkhmSTZGdEVDOGNEOVFaY3RnUFZTRjJLdmdPMjFmNU5UTzhXS3h5MEZmdlp6b0dScHlKcUJhUmNSU3hqTnM5TEJsbXQ1dlE3elFiVjNfNXprVnVvdDVTVDk2VVpldHhJLTFFRDdheXlqYWFodFF0bHVRR202UFhRZUE)认为暂停打击显示美国影响力有限。
- **红海与非洲之角新风险：** [ECFR](https://news.google.)警告下一次危机可能在非洲之角爆发。中国据报也在寻求自己的红海通道，[TradeWinds](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPcFE1RmVRc2liQ3M4S0VmNWxnWC1MMjlScmxDck9TN3dITUUyOVhjdWZOVHNJNkFZOTc3SFh4SG5iSUhnVjc1VjJYUUhhZmphS0ZxeHVha3dzTEFiNDV0NUs5Y0lDcEJ2T283NXp0QzBNSDEzOVVpNGxDYk5MUGVJZzZCWUdrb0FjU19nMFpzMGFJamg2ZDVsbWZCX3lmRmZh)进一步复杂化大国博弈。

**收束：** 伊朗-乌克兰冲突联动使特朗普难以保持战略聚焦，中东与东欧战线的交叉迫使美国加速武器调配与外交斡旋。
冲突局势.en:
The 冲突局势 desk highlights the merging of the Ukraine and Iran wars, with a Ukrainian strike on an Iranian ship in the Caspian Sea killing one sailor and threatening retaliation. Meanwhile, President Trump met separately with Netanyahu and Zelenskyy, citing 'good' talks on Iran while reiterating threats. Analysts suggest the conflict is spreading beyond its original boundaries.
- [Ukraine strikes Iranian ship in Caspian Sea](https://news.google.): Iran condemns the attack, threatens retaliation, further linking the two theaters.
- [Trump meets Netanyahu and Zelenskyy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQckxLYkJwbm5YQU0wbC1HWEgxWmFWeHJHeVBUZ3pLbzVPTHNBUUMxWlR1eFVnTmhnbTFpU19LaW1TM1BJV0pjVnA5WHlKVy1HbmppbV9zcVdsVzVUaDZ2Q3dqalliOF9IRDVaWFlhMHVzb2VxVkthWVZhcTJvVmNSXzBCN0xxUERkMXpCOWt6RVVxb2ktNEVkMA): White House diplomacy aimed at managing overlapping crises.
- [Iran war spreading analysis](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxOcWU2OTVtcWVtbFZ6TkdEeW51aWNjYzQyZC1TQXUxMDJJOUhEX2pFSExtZGkyU1JKOTlLcTg2SzdIbG5MdlByZng1aW9BUW5hcFgwbFNsNmFSbUx1cjVHRTlTaHRUMURnaHl5U0VkRndsbm5tREJzdWRrNFFwd3U4TW1YaXJIOW9vMlFmVlBuOF9Zdk9OZkVYWXZ6bjNlMTVDNlFFQS05Qmd4YjVTRXdzOHJoLWdRVXRpWm1uQWhDcF8): Multiple outlets note the widening scope of the conflict.
- [China seeking Red Sea pathway](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPcFE1RmVRc2liQ3M4S0VmNWxnWC1MMjlScmxDck9TN3dITUUyOVhjdWZOVHNJNkFZOTc3SFh4SG5iSUhnVjc1VjJYUUhhZmphS0ZxeHVha3dzTEFiNDV0NUs5Y0lDcEJ2T283NXp0QzBNSDEzOVVpNGxDYk5MUGVJZzZCWUdrb0FjU19nMFpzMGFJamg2ZDVsbWZCX3lmRmZh): Reports suggest Beijing is exploring its own maritime corridor, adding a new dimension.
- [Blurred front lines: Ukraine and Iran wars collide](https://news.google.): CNBC analyzes the diplomatic and military entanglement.
**Signal**: The Ukrainian strike on an Iranian vessel is a dangerous escalatory step that could force Washington to manage a two-front crisis, with the Red Sea and Horn of Africa emerging as potential flashpoints.

中国军情.zh:
**概览：** 解放军在渤海黄海执行军事任务，台海方向首次实现直升机与无人机同时越入管控区；美国新一批“中国军事企业清单”引发反弹，南海外交博弈持续。

- **台海军事压力升级：** 解放军直升机与无人机首次同时越过台海中线，进入台湾方面管控区域。[朝鲜日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxPX0JhTXV4OGtzaWU4OHBHc0gyOTlLOVdPU2Vac2djOVNFSjJfV0VtVXJ5TXhHd21SSEhFQUg3Vnp2MmdWN3NrYTB3UmFRTnF5N2NsbG9hQWF3Z09pMUlZQjFiQVpVUXJDQURveXFMOXJBUjJzMW8yUEpkZkpUcWFaRmJ4UlJ1M3FfZzhJYnp3)此举被解读为对台施加更大压力。
- **美军拉黑中企，中国反制：** 美国将部分中国企业列入“中国军事企业清单”，中国商务部表示坚决反对。[财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag)同时，中国史无前例地将一所波兰大学列入“黑名单”，[文学城](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE8xUEpUTDJxa2ctbFZZbVh3djlpTFZ6WE1Mcy1KR214S2Q3eE9qUVozNXJ0ZU1JZEFCWjZBX0FTdXFxZFR2SFBjcWZBWVd2UG1QanRhYmI3SldLc1J4ZUZoZ0dtLXF1TTJu)显示科技教育领域的反制扩大。
- **南海“缝网”与菲律宾态度：** 中国国防部长访问文莱，[Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPZVFhZUR2bFRpSUtzSzJFUVdWU2ZLbDFHZ1Q0bndJaVhiVGFDSVdTM0NlTm1UNGFvS2xURHdYMV85MTd5YTdBbVRhcWFZQlIxMzN2cndxM0c2Z21wTmJkTnJTZzRNUEhPVTktb1ZPV3V2QTRuSWs1M2VWRzQwOHFobE1QdUZIS0FtcE12Yg)形容“南海正被缝成一张网”。菲律宾总统小马科斯则称“人性遭质疑，绝不屈服”，[RFI](https://news.google.)凸显南海紧张对峙。
- **中国核武库与台海靶标：** 美智库分析中国远程核导弹能力增长，[TWZ](https://www.twz.com/nuclear/a-guide-to-chinas-growing-long-range-nuclear-missile-arsenal)新唐人报道称中国沙漠中暗设模拟台北“总统府”的靶标，[新唐人](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFBlaE5ESm5SMHJkUXZIVU85dDZMaXBPeGZQYnQ3OWNmVG1lb1JNYTBLckQ4aXRZX2tXZy13aXF4Z0ptTEhYSEFZbElWRGZxUDRPWmVXeE04YnZlVURfR1BRU9IBZkFVX3lxTE16c0JVVml3WC1KT0szM3Q3bVdySmhIalZnQlVjeWlNWjJQaVdMZmVnVVVCdU5ZSEE2UWlOVnZLdmZRMTJoX2UzaUdVWEZIRURLYXdUWGhVLWVYNTF1cHVNRVEteHVmUQ)显示对台打击准备。

**收束：** 中国在台海、南海的军力展示更加系统化，同时通过外交与制裁手段反制美方打压，地区紧张格局短期难缓。
中国军情.en:
China’s military assertiveness continues to rise, with multiple incidents in the past 24 hours: a navigation warning for live-fire drills in the Bohai and Yellow Seas, Chinese aircraft crossing the Taiwan Strait median line, and a marked increase in PLA activity near Japan. The U.S. added more Chinese firms to its 'China Military Companies List,' while Beijing blacklisted a Polish university—an unprecedented move. A new report details China's growing long-range nuclear arsenal.
- [Chinese aircraft cross Taiwan Strait median line](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxPX0JhTXV4OGtzaWU4OHBHc0gyOTlLOVdPU2Vac2djOVNFSjJfV0VtVXJ5TXhHd21SSEhFQUg3Vnp2MmdWN3NrYTB3UmFRTnF5N2NsbG9hQWF3Z09pMUlZQjFiQVpVUXJDQURveXFMOXJBUjJzMW8yUEpkZkpUcWFaRmJ4UlJ1M3FfZzhJYnp3): Helicopters and drones entered the restricted zone simultaneously for the first time.
- [Bohai and Yellow Sea military drills](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE1sOEhCRWl4RlhzWW9ZVzBOZzRPRVJGODBaMnN1dnp2bHEyVll6eVJHU0tVTzdRTlZBRGw5UEtpSDFGVVk0WFRWeHdjTGVNYVJrOWI5STg4bHJmZ0xfSDh0VHJUbnhQdnBYUHRR): China issues navigation warning, prohibiting vessel entry, likely for anti-ship or anti-air exercises.
- [China blacklists Polish university](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE8xUEpUTDJxa2ctbFZZbVh3djlpTFZ6WE1Mcy1KR214S2Q3eE9qUVozNXJ0ZU1JZEFCWjZBX0FTdXFxZFR2SFBjcWZBWVd2UG1QanRhYmI3SldLc1J4ZUZoZ0dtLXF1TTJu): Unprecedented move signals Beijing's willingness to use sanctions in academic/tech disputes.
- [U.S. adds Chinese firms to military list](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag): Commerce Ministry responds, escalating tech rivalry.
- [China's nuclear missile arsenal detailed](https://www.twz.com/nuclear/a-guide-to-chinas-growing-long-range-nuclear-missile-arsenal): A comprehensive guide shows expanding ICBM and SLBM capabilities, reinforcing strategic deterrence.
- [Desert target resembling Taipei Presidential Office](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFBlaE5ESm5SMHJkUXZIVU85dDZMaXBPeGZQYnQ3OWNmVG1lb1JNYTBLckQ4aXRZX2tXZy13aXF4Z0ptTEhYSEFZbElWRGZxUDRPWmVXeE04YnZlVURfR1BRU9IBZkFVX3lxTE16c0JVVml3WC1KT0szM3Q3bVdySmhIalZnQlVjeWlNWjJQaVdMZmVnVVVCdU5ZSEE2UWlOVnZLdmZRMTJoX2UzaUdVWEZIRURLYXdUWGhVLWVYNTF1cHVNRVEteHVmUQ): Experts warn of mock-up for strike training, signaling intent against Taiwan.
**Signal**: China is simultaneously testing Taiwan’s airspace, expanding its nuclear arsenal, and imposing new sanctions—signaling a hardening stance that will complicate any U.S. effort to focus on the Middle East.

海军与印太.zh:
**概览：** 美菲加强海岸警卫合作，中俄联合巡逻逼近日本；美国国会要求海军大幅扩充鱼雷库存以应对两线战争；波兰订购A26潜艇，老旧航母报废成本高昂。

- **美资助菲律宾扩建南海基地：** 美国承诺提供至多900万美元扩建巴拉望岛海岸警卫队码头，以增强南海执法存在。[USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/28/u-s-to-fund-philippine-coast-guard-base-expansion-near-south-china-sea)此举直指中国在南海的活动。
- **中俄海军联合巡逻日本周边：** 中国海军055型驱逐舰安山舰、开封舰等与俄舰船在日本北海道南部海域进行年度联合巡逻，日本自卫队全程监视。[USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/28/joint-russian-chinese-navy-patrol-sails-near-japan)
- **美国海军鱼雷库存大检查：** 《2027财年国防授权法案》指示海军部长对鱼雷库存进行全面审查，目标是维持足以支撑两场主要地区冲突的储备量。[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-torpedo-inventory-fy27-ndaa/)
- **潜艇动态：** “俄亥俄”级巡航导弹核潜艇“乔治亚”号即将退役，[TWZ](https://www.twz.com/sea/prized-ohio-class-guided-missile-submarine-uss-georgia-heading-into-retirement)全部该级潜艇将在三年内退出现役；波兰则敲定3艘A26型潜艇订单，并租用瑞典“南曼兰”号作为过渡。[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/poland-a26-submarine-deal-weapons-interim-boat-schedule/)
- **造船与报废成本：** HII扩大分布式造船至两栖舰领域，[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/hii-expands-distributed-shipbuilding-to-amphibious-ships/)“企业”号航母报废总账单已达13亿美元。[USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/28/final-bill-for-inactivating-scrapping-carrier-enterprise-now-at-1-3b)

**收束：** 印太方向，美国通过资助盟友、强化潜艇力量与鱼雷储备来对冲中国海军扩展，中俄联合巡逻进一步展示军事协作，地区军备竞赛态势清晰。
海军与印太.en:
In the Indo-Pacific, the U.S. announced funding for a Philippine Coast Guard base expansion on Palawan, directly supporting South China Sea operations. A joint Russia-China naval patrol sailed near Japan, while the U.S. Congress directed a torpedo inventory overhaul to prepare for two major regional conflicts. Additionally, Poland’s A26 submarine deal and the scrapping of USS Enterprise highlight global naval modernization and decommissioning trends.
- [U.S. funds Philippine Coast Guard base](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/28/u-s-to-fund-philippine-coast-guard-base-expansion-near-south-china-sea): Up to $9 million for pier expansion on Palawan to enhance maritime law enforcement presence.
- [Russia-China joint patrol near Japan](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/28/joint-russian-chinese-navy-patrol-sails-near-japan): PLAN cruiser, destroyer, and oiler operating with Russian corvette south of Hokkaido; annual patrol indicates deepening coordination.
- [Congress mandates torpedo inventory review for two-war strategy](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-torpedo-inventory-fy27-ndaa/): FY27 NDAA requires SECNAV to overhaul torpedo production to support simultaneous major conflicts.
- [Poland orders A26 submarines](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/poland-a26-submarine-deal-weapons-interim-boat-schedule): Three Swedish-built Blekinge-class boats with interim lease of HMS Södermanland; delivery by 2031.
- [USS Enterprise scrapping costs $1.3B](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/28/final-bill-for-inactivating-scrapping-carrier-enterprise-now-at-1-3b): Final cost for recycling the first nuclear carrier underscores the expense of nuclear decommissioning.
- [HII expands distributed shipbuilding to amphibious ships](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/hii-expands-distributed-shipbuilding-to-amphibious-ships): Modular construction begins for LPD 32 Philadelphia, building on destroyer program success.
**Signal**: The U.S. is reinforcing its ally network in the South China Sea while preparing for a two-war scenario, but the retirement of key platforms like the USS Georgia and the high cost of decommissioning may strain resources exactly when they are most needed.

AI.zh: AI领域今日剧烈震荡。芯片股因投资者对AI资本开支回报的质疑而普跌（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cly8zng43npo)）。安全层面，OpenAI最近遭遇的“前所未有”攻击被MIT Tech Review定性为“可预见的”，因为类似模式早已出现（[MIT Technology Review](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/28/1140868/the-download-openai-hack-ai-stock-sell-off/)）。与此同时，超过1100名AI专家联合呼吁全球暂停前沿AI开发（[KuCoin](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOMEVBRUw0UXM1cUNNcmMxSjhVRG9Ga2EtNHdZMElzNzVjT2VlamlLU21laVhsd1phb2xVamZYY2hvbEhmRWR2QjAyekJmN09TaFR2Yks3RXJoVnlGcjFhaEJSQ0hZLUQydk1mOV9vb1RqbDJkaHJVRTZCV1RLS0tkOFUtUDBhYTZrU0hBaUVJWnZyZGRzMHNLb1d4R1pfSnp3QnJGUjNZdkN1aFE)），OpenAI和Anthropic员工也在推动加强监管（[Chosunbiz](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE0yb2t6V3ptZ0dIU3RQaVZuel91VTAwajd5ZWpkNElhekFwSUFuRGh5QTdiUkE5bGZ4OE1FSE1qeFFIN19PWVRmOUtmRkFjbXNPZ1ZVZG9OUnEtZFdMR0toYlloWUxBQVI0eEEwMjZQdHc5T0RaN21fc3hR)）。在正面消息中，Andrew Ng的AI公司LearnVector推出个性化一对一学习体验（[Hacker News](https://learnvector.ai/)），获85点社区关注。总体而言，AI行业正经历“技术乐观主义”与“安全现实主义”的激烈碰撞，短期内监管预期将持续压制估值。
AI.en:
The AI sector is under intense pressure following a security breach at OpenAI that rattled investor confidence, triggering a sell-off in chip stocks globally. Over 1,100 AI experts have called for a slowdown in frontier development, and staff at OpenAI and Anthropic are urging stronger US oversight. Despite the turmoil, innovation continues: Andrew Ng's startup LearnVector launched a personalized learning platform, and a new agentic IDE called Capuchin was announced. The community is also discussing AI-written fiction on Amazon and policy proposals for GCC.

- **AI stock sell-off** – Chip stocks fell as the market reacted to OpenAI's "unprecedented" hack and broader concerns over AI spending. The sell-off was felt in both US and Asian markets. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cly8zng43npo)
- **Calls for a global slowdown** – More than 1,100 AI experts signed an open letter urging a temporary halt in frontier AI development. Separately, current and former staff at OpenAI and Anthropic pressed US policymakers for stronger oversight. [The Straits Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPYmIzT3dZQzhqRElRd0VBSHQ0LThJYjlOM0tGUGZ5TzBBZFRybUVDandSZ0t3NGxoQ0NMMlNrYmkwNlZfWFdubmNqUEFFQ2xGRkFBS1lSUXNBYXh0Q05wRnhFbm42ejRYTnNibURpcVR0eUhxVXl6RHBzOUFCb3U1MVBTekVfRERPc01LRGtxRVlMRm40bC1xRTdhNS1GT2NWVkRMSXRGVjNlVGpmTEtwSjQ2MG0) | [KuCoin](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOMEVBRUw0UXM1cUNNcmMxSjhVRG9Ga2EtNHdZMElzNzVjT2VlamlLU21laVhsd1phb2xVamZYY2hvbEhmRWR2QjAyekJmN09TaFR2Yks3RXJoVnlGcjFhaEJSQ0hZLUQydk1mOV9vb1RqbDJkaHJVRTZCV1RLS0tkOFUtUDBhYTZrU0hBaUVJWnZyZGRzMHNLb1d4R1pfSnp3QnJGUjNZdkN1aFE)
- **Andrew Ng's LearnVector** – The AI educator's new company launched a platform for personalized one-to-one learning experiences, quickly rising to #2 on Hacker News. [Hacker News](https://learnvector.ai/)
- **AI-written fiction on Amazon** – Data shows a sharp rise in AI-generated book sales from 2023 to 2026, sparking debate on the platform's content policies. [Twitter](https://twitter.com/TuhinChakr/status/2082124139973030095)

**Signal:** The combination of a high-profile security incident and a coordinated expert demand for a pause suggests that the AI industry's regulatory reckoning may be accelerating, with potential implications for investment and deployment timelines.

科技产品.zh: 科技产品板块政策与法律事件密集。美国FCC宣布禁止进口外国制造的人形机器人和电源逆变器，明确针对中国，旨在重振国内制造（[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2225693/the-us-is-banning-foreign-made-humanoid-robots-and-power-inverters/)）。法律方面，eBay及三名前高管就2019年针对一对记者夫妇的恶性网络跟踪案支付5570万美元和解金，内容包括送活昆虫、血腥猪面具等（[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/ebay-former-execs-pay-56m-to-settle-bloody-pig-mask-harassment-case/)）；Ariana Grande也就歌曲与视频泄露对匿名黑客提起诉讼（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/972233/ariana-grande-hacking-lawsuit)）。融资方面，机器人检测初创公司Spur从Insight Partners获得2亿美元投资（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/28/bot-detection-startup-spur-nabs-200m-from-insight/)）。此外，MCP初创公司Runlayer起诉Rippling窃取产品创意（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/28/mcp-startup-runlayer-accuses-rippling-of-stealing-its-product-idea/)），凸显企业创新中的知识产权博弈。这些事件共同表明：科技产品的竞争已从单纯功能创新延伸至合规、安全与法律战场。
科技产品.en:
A mix of policy, security, and legal news dominated the tech products landscape. The US announced a ban on foreign-made humanoid robots and power inverters, directly targeting China's robotics exports. eBay's long-running cyberstalking saga ended with a $56M settlement. Meanwhile, bot-detection startup Spur raised $200M from Insight Partners, and Wikimedia Foundation employees expanded their union drive.

- **US bans foreign humanoid robots** – The FCC imposed an import ban on advanced mobile robots (humanoid, quadruped) and power inverters from foreign countries, citing national security. The move is widely seen as aimed at Chinese manufacturers. [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2225693/the-us-is-banning-foreign-made-humanoid-robots-and-power-inverters/) | [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/972259/us-foreign-robots-power-inverter-ban)
- **eBay settles cyberstalking case for $56M** – eBay and three former executives paid the sum to journalist couple Ina and David Steiner, who were targeted with a bizarre harassment campaign including a bloody pig mask and live insects after critiquing the company. [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/ebay-former-execs-pay-56m-to-settle-bloody-pig-mask-harassment-case/) | [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/972209/ebay-cyberstalking-harassment-settlement)
- **Bot-detection startup Spur raises $200M** – Spur Intelligence, which identifies human vs bot traffic, secured the funding from Insight Partners, highlighting growing demand for anti-fraud tech. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/28/bot-detection-startup-spur-nabs-200m-from-insight/)
- **Wikimedia Foundation union drive expands** – US-based employees joined UK staff in seeking union recognition, but management has declined to voluntarily recognize it. [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/news/972182/wikipedia-wikimedia-foundation-union-editor-strike)

**Signal:** The US robot ban signals an escalation in tech decoupling, while the eBay settlement and Spur funding underscore the growing legal and security risks in the digital marketplace.

汽车.zh: 汽车板块今日围绕电动化与自动驾驶展开。沙特王子Alwaleed披露持有Lucid 5%股份，推动股价暴涨25%，为这家现金告急的电动汽车制造商带来重要背书（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/saudi-prince-alwaleed-5-percent-lucid-stake-lcid/)）。百度Apollo Go同日启动伦敦Robotaxi路测，并同时与Uber和Freenow（Lyft）合作，标志中国自动驾驶公司首次进入右舵市场（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/baidu-apollo-go-london-robotaxi-testing-uber-lyft/)）。然而特斯拉的FSD再次面临质疑：前测试经理在诉讼中称，由于安全员严重短缺，测试车辆成为“滚动隐患”（[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2225645/tesla-full-self-driving-cars-were-rolling-hazards-fired-manager/)）。大众ID.Polo以低于3万美元起售价上市，已获2.5万订单（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/volkswagen-launches-cheaper-id-polo-ev-orders-25000/)）；宝马iX3订单接近10万，正加速增产（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/bmw-ramps-up-ix3-output-orders-near-100000/)）。传统车企在廉价电动车领域正形成合围之势，而特斯拉的自动驾驶叙事则面临法律与声誉的双重压力。
汽车.en:
A dramatic day for EVs: Saudi billionaire Prince Alwaleed took a 5% stake in Lucid, sending shares up 25%. Baidu's Apollo Go began robotaxi road testing in London with both Uber and Lyft's Freenow. A former Tesla manager's lawsuit alleges that the company's Full Self-Driving test fleet was understaffed and dangerous. Volkswagen opened orders for a cheaper ID. Polo EV, and BMW's iX3 orders approached 100,000.

- **Lucid gets Saudi boost** – Prince Alwaleed bin Talal disclosed a 5% passive stake in Lucid Group, reassuring investors of continued Saudi backing. The stock jumped 25% on the news. [Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/saudi-prince-alwaleed-5-percent-lucid-stake-lcid/)
- **Baidu Apollo Go launches in London** – The robotaxi service started testing on London streets with Uber and Freenow, marking a key expansion after a fully driverless trial in Hong Kong. [Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/baidu-apollo-go-london-robotaxi-testing-uber-lyft/)
- **Tesla self-driving manager files lawsuit** – Former Houston fleet manager Javier Medrano claims the robotaxi operation was so understaffed that vehicles became "rolling hazards on public streets." The lawsuit raises safety concerns ahead of Tesla's planned driverless robotaxi launch. [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2225645/tesla-full-self-driving-cars-were-rolling-hazards-fired-manager/) | [Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/tesla-self-driving-manager-rolling-hazards-lawsuit/)
- **Volkswagen ID. Polo cheaper variant** – With a 37 kWh battery and sub-$30,000 price, VW opened orders after already securing 25,000 orders for the standard version. [Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/volkswagen-launches-cheaper-id-polo-ev-orders-25000/)
- **BMW iX3 orders near 100,000** – BMW is ramping up production of the electric SUV at a record pace to meet strong demand. [Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/bmw-ramps-up-ix3-output-orders-near-100000/)

**Signal:** The convergence of Lucid's financial lifeline, Baidu's global robotaxi push, and Tesla's safety allegations paints a picture of an EV industry at a critical inflection point—capital is flowing, competition is globalizing, but operational risks are being exposed.

HackNews社区动态.zh: 社区动态呈现浓厚的“复古与创新”交织氛围。《半条命》被成功移植到Mac OS 9，以186点和92条评论登顶热点，展现经典游戏社区的持久热情（[Hacker News](https://mac-classic.com/news/half-life-ported-to-mac-os-9/)）。工具类项目活跃：Hubble开源笔记应用支持人类与AI代理协作（[Hacker News](https://www.hubble.md/)），获68点；Manim（3Blue1Brown动画引擎）通过WebGPU在浏览器中实现GPU加速渲染（[Hacker News](https://studio.academa.ai/)），解决了Python动画库的部署痛点。另外，ReFrame电子纸相机（[Hacker News](https://reframe.camera/)）和Wayland多鼠标光标实现（[Hacker News](https://blinry.org/multi-seat-wayland/)）也获得较高关注。值得留意的是，一个旨在合并HN文章与评论页面的userscript（[Hacker News](https://github.com/twalichiewicz/HNewhere)）反映了用户对社区讨论体验的持续优化需求。总体来看，社区更青睐那些“解决实际痛点”或“复活旧技术”的项目，而非宏大叙事。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community was alive with nostalgia and innovation. The top post by far was a port of Half-Life to Mac OS 9 (186 points), a technical feat that sparked memories and discussions. Other highlights included open-source tools: Hubble, an AI-friendly note-taking app, and a WebGPU-powered version of 3Blue1Brown's Manim animation engine. A thoughtful essay on the difference between buttons and links resonated with designers and developers.

- **Half-Life ported to Mac OS 9** – A developer successfully ran the classic game on the vintage operating system, drawing 186 points and 92 comments on Hacker News. [Hacker News](https://mac-classic.com/news/half-life-ported-to-mac-os-9/)
- **Hubble: Open-source notetaking for humans and agents** – A new app that lets you take notes and share them with AI agents, inspired by the need for structured knowledge. Received 68 points and 14 comments. [Hacker News](https://www.hubble.md/)
- **Manim in the browser via WebGPU** – A Show HN project reimplemented 3Blue1Brown's animation engine in Rust with WebGPU, allowing math animations to run entirely in the browser. [Hacker News](https://studio.academa.ai/)
- **Design deep-dive: Buttons vs. Links** – An essay on the critical UX difference between the two elements garnered 49 points and 30 comments, reflecting the community's interest in UI fundamentals. [Hacker News](https://unplannedobsolescence.com/blog/buttons-vs-links/)

**Signal:** The community's mix of retro computing projects and modern AI-integrated tools shows that Hacker News remains a hub for both technical craftsmanship and forward-looking utility, with a strong emphasis on open-source and user control.

足球.zh: 今日欧洲足坛多线震荡：齐达内时隔五年再执教鞭，正式出任法国队主帅，他能否驾驭姆巴佩、格列兹曼等巨星阵容成为焦点；同时切尔西新帅阿隆索在首场季前赛中四名前锋轮番登场，但球队锋线去留问题悬而未决。转会市场方面，**布拉德利·巴尔科拉**已口头同意加盟利物浦，但巴黎与红军在估值上仍有分歧；曼城边锋**萨维尼奥**则表达离队意愿并倾向热刺。此外，意大利足球经历16天混乱后，**罗伯特·曼奇尼**临危受命接手国家队；凯尔特人则以破队史纪录签下丹麦前锋**卡斯珀·霍格**。国际足联推动世界杯私有化计划遭欧足联及英国首相公开批评，争议持续发酵。后续关注齐达内首期大名单与英超各队季前磨合。
足球.en:
European football dominates the day with managerial changes at France and Chelsea, a record signing for Celtic, and ongoing transfer sagas. Meanwhile, Italian football's governance crisis resolves with Roberto Mancini, and FIFA faces backlash over World Cup investment plans.

- Zinedine Zidane's long-awaited appointment as France manager raises questions about how he will integrate star talents like Mbappé and Griezmann. [Zidane waited for France](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c20dxgpjng3o)
- Xabi Alonso's Chelsea debut saw a hat-trick from one striker and potential exits for others, highlighting immediate squad decisions. [Alonso's first Chelsea match](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c1w13ddr4ejo)
- Italian football's chaotic 16-day manager search ends with Mancini, but the resignations of Maldini and Leonardo signal deeper issues. [After 16 days of chaos](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cddj2m5m0p0o)
- Celtic break their transfer record to sign Kasper Hogh from Bodo/Glimt on a four-year deal, strengthening their attack for Champions League qualifiers. [Celtic record signing](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cwymjrm0xlwo)
- Transfer gossip: PSG's Bradley Barcola verbally agrees to join Liverpool, but clubs disagree on fee; Manchester City's Savinho is open to a move to Tottenham. [Barcola](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/czrj8ke23g3o), [Savinho](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2kqvkwz17o)
- FIFA's plan to seek private investment for the World Cup, including sovereign wealth funds, is condemned by UEFA and UK PM Andy Burnham. [Uefa and PM criticise](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c8xng9894z0o)
- Chinese community forecasts Real Madrid's starting XI for the new season, with speculation on line-up changes. [皇马新赛季首发11人预计出炉](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE44UnFXMDV6VXhGRjRJX0Jfb25TaHRXQTBKUEF6UEQ5SENXV1pjX195TS1YeHlzOV8xVGpCX2FjS1BMaVluV1M5M0tJcFV3d3VQTlRrSWZDcTJHQkVNNmQ0Z3ZTXzV1R1JGdnZjMmxkWU1HUQ)

**Closing signal:** The transfer window's intensity coupled with new manager appointments across top clubs sets the stage for a transformative season ahead.

篮球.zh: 今日CBA选秀大会成为国内篮球最大看点：**宋昕澔**以状元身份加盟，其年薪1475万人民币对比NBA状元薪资引发热议；新疆队在第五顺位选中**张俊生**并在次轮摘得**王一为**。媒体人普遍呼吁选秀制度改革，涉及新秀权益、选材面及签位规则。NBA方面，杜兰特在评论詹姆斯加盟76人时直言球员目标无非冠军、球权与金钱，引发虎扑热议。广东男篮新帅公布阵容，重用徐杰、崔永熙等五将。另外，上赛季效力CBA的**洛夫顿**正式签约以色列豪门，印证欧洲联赛对顶级外援的吸引力。后续可关注CBA各队签约进展及NBA自由市场余波。
篮球.en:
The 2026 CBA Draft was the centerpiece of Chinese basketball news, with Xinjiang selecting Zhang Junsheng 5th overall and Wang Yiwei in the second round. Media pundits are calling for draft system reforms, while the appeal of European leagues as a stepping stone or alternative to the NBA continues to grow.

- The CBA Draft saw Xinjiang take Zhang Junsheng at #5 and Wang Yiwei later; other teams made picks amid discussions on talent development. [CBA draft](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE5jRUZUQzVyNFcxUk9LRmNWQ1Fza19Lb1V2MDRMekM3bENKaVRyZFlqOGszTGdZc2d2RWhCWGNtUk9jMkVLV3FLQ0dYc1dWNlpRbGt3cEMwdm1ZV0w2MVYyZFpLLTZLSUlkak1ZQkdRcw)
- A media analyst argues the draft must reform rookie rights, selection scope, and pick trading rules to improve the league's competitiveness. [Draft reform](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPeU1mMVlUZGhDa1JKenNBV3Q0VXA4ZnhSamtYTDc1VDhDU1dlWmZINHl4Ui12VFdOOGgtZ2oxVFctazV5TnhFcGJaaWkyelJCckE3ZV9iRUdrbjktVTRLZGJOc0ZYT0FMT1BUM2pSYnM3b0xVbXUzR2NpLURzeGhPMEdOZkI)
- European leagues are described as 'the stage second only to the NBA,' offering better contract guarantees and attracting talent from China and elsewhere. [European leagues](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQUzJsTlhiYWhUZ2UyUXVrY1Zrb2hWeU50N0paMWVYbDJfc2hQM2pEWkpNbTBySEhJemhGZDlSYzJvdWZIN3pkQWRXZTlfdzlpbHJFbkFyUndSa1BHWU53OTNVaU9KbWUtdGRMNF9ybG9LWHowUW5sOFVsQ0ZYS2lmbF9Yb3o)
- Former NBA player Kenneth Lofton Jr. leaves the CBA to join an Israeli club; he once scored 42 points and 14 rebounds in an NBA game. [Lofton](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPN1NYQVZDNmI1dVpyY3V0dlZ0alNnMExjWE51bnFaa190aDRUYW1LSW0xQXA2UUJOeUJIalNjVE9DRUl1RnVxQUk0UktuN2l2TVpKZlRZMmxRX29xMG9PbnQzR3FSN2FuYm9YR01Vd1dhczVMd01ickRDZWpsYkdhajV4ZUNUREQ1TndqQg)
- Kevin Durant comments on LeBron James potentially joining the 76ers, stating players' motivations are titles, ball usage, and money. [Durant James](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBERjlTcFFPZGJ0UGhLSFI3Rm9jcVZIbEVJTzJyTlhSdGZwa2hDQ2ZLZDJfcExQajVCbkZRbk5Yek43NjBsa2ktWTA2eDZaQkVJTEdicHhmbk01clR3SDJKblAyRQ)

**Closing signal:** The CBA's ability to retain talent and modernize its draft will determine whether it can compete with Europe's growing allure as a development destination.

虎扑社区动态.zh: 虎扑今日热门话题包括：美媒B/R晒出下赛季薪资比詹姆斯（仅390万美元）还高的球员名单，包括小乔丹、海斯等，引发对詹姆斯“童工合同”的调侃；CBA选秀后新疆官方欢迎张俊生、王一为加入；陕西联合因球迷投掷冷焰火被罚款2万元，社区讨论安保尺度；此外，夏窗转会中心焕新上线，为足球迷提供整合信息；电竞方面，TES战队分享打野Tian生日返图。整体社区呈现体育与泛娱乐交叉的热闹氛围。后续关注转会窗口关闭前的虎扑讨论热度。
虎扑社区动态.en:
Community discussions on Hupu span NBA salary curiosities, CBA draft welcomes, and disciplinary actions in Chinese football. The platform also launches a revamped transfer centre for the summer window.

- Bleacher Report highlights that LeBron James's $3.9M salary next season is lower than many players, including rookies and even a coach, sparking widespread debate. [B/R salary list](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9QN0ZqUHI3WUxLcW45am8yVlJlWloxQmdESWlkR3F5cVRWcFhQZUVTM1hobjlvbXU1NEg4dGd1aTQ4T1dkUk9KOFpjWTI4ZXRaZGJoT2R3cTRoRlM0OExFbzRIMA)

欧美.zh:
今日欧美娱乐板块聚焦多起政治与文化冲突：Noah Kahan抗议白宫擅用其歌曲、Evan Rachel Wood因剧本偏离原著退出《Practical Magic 2》、Ryan Murphy考虑重启《Glee》。此外，《Jumanji: Open World》预告片发布，系列终章定档年底；《Star Wars》现场VFX员工工会化取得进展。

- [Noah Kahan Slams White House for Using His Song in Trump Promo Video](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/noah-kahan-white-house-music-trump-video-1235600195/) 三媒互证，艺人政治立场鲜明。
- [Evan Rachel Wood “Sad” About Not Returning For ‘Practical Magic 2’](https://deadline.com/2026/07/evan-rachel-wood-not-returning-practical-magic-2-sequel-1237006305/) 原班人马回归不确定性增加。
- [‘Jumanji: Open World’ Trailer Sees Core Four Group Unleashed In Real Life](https://deadline.com/2026/07/jumanji-3-open-world-trailer-dwayne-johnson-jack-black-1237006351/) 系列三部曲收官，期待值高。
- [‘Star Wars’ On-Set Visual Effects Workers Unionize](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/star-wars-on-set-vfx-workers-unionize-1236658337/) 迪士尼系制作劳动力结构变化。
- [Wasserman Buy Out Moves Forward With Investment From Providence](https://deadline.com/2026/07/wasserman-deal-providence-investment-1237006376/) 经纪行业资本重组加速。

欧美娱乐业正处于政治敏感性与大型IP迭代的交叉节点，艺人维权与内容创作自由度将持续成为话题。
欧美.en:
The Western entertainment desk reports a mix of franchise nostalgia, political music disputes, and industry consolidation. Notably, 'Jumanji: Open World' trailer dropped across multiple outlets, marking the trilogy's conclusion with Dwayne Johnson and Jack Black. Meanwhile, Noah Kahan's confrontation with the Trump administration over his song 'American Cars' dominated headlines, reflecting a growing trend of artists asserting control over their work. On the business side, Wasserman's buyout moves forward with Providence investment, while 'Star Wars' on-set VFX workers unionize, signaling labor shifts.

- [‘Jumanji: Open World’ Trailer: Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart and Jack Black Return for Third and Final Movie](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/jumanji-3-trailer-dwayne-johnson-kevin-hart-open-world-1236706410/) — The trailer reveals a new premise where the video game avatars are unleashed into the real world, generating high anticipation for the December release.
- [Noah Kahan Slams White House for Using His Song in Trump Promo Video](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/noah-kahan-white-house-music-trump-video-1235600195/) — The singer's public rebuke highlights the ongoing friction between artists and political campaigns, especially with an election cycle looming.
- [Wasserman Buy Out Moves Forward With Investment From Providence](https://deadline.com/2026/07/wasserman-deal-providence-investment-1237006376/) — Providence Equity Partners invests additional capital, paving the way for Michael Watts to become CEO and signaling a major restructuring in talent representation.
- [‘Star Wars’ On-Set Visual Effects Workers Unionize](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/star-wars-on-set-vfx-workers-unionize-1236658337/) — Staff on 'Ahsoka' and 'Starfighter' join IATSE, a win for labor rights in visual effects, a sector historically resistant to unionization.
- [Evan Rachel Wood Says She’s Not Returning for ‘Practical Magic 2’ Because It’s “Not Following the Book”](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/evan-rachel-wood-practical-magic-2-not-following-book-1236658715/) — This creative schism may affect fan expectations for the sequel, which aims to recapture the original's magic but apparently diverges from Alice Hoffman's source material.

Closing: The intersection of political music appropriation and franchise filmmaking continues to shape the discourse; expect more artist statements and union activity ahead.
